Political Participation.english: We should introduce  citizens' initiatives at the country level.
Political Participation.original: Seadustame rahvaalgatuse võimaluse. (http://www.ekre.ee/ekreprogramm/programm/riik-ja-valitsemine/)

Investing in Youth.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Future of Europe.english: Estonia must reinforce cooperation with the EU, other states and international organisations in areas such as the environment, economy, energy and the fight against organised crime, where  collective action by states is most effective.
Future of Europe.original: Eesti püüab tugevdada Euroopa Liidu, riikide ja rahvusvaheliste organisatsioonide koostööd ja riigiülest tegevust nendes valdkondades, kus riigi enda tugevusest ei piisa, nagu keskkonna-, majandus- ja energeetikaalane koostöö, võitlus organiseeritud kuritegevusega jne.(http://www.ekre.ee/ekreprogramm/programm/valis-ja-julgeolekupoliitika/)

Environment.english: We support the development and utilisation of  environmentally friendly technologies and products.
Environment.original: Toetame keskkonnasõbralike tehnoloogiate ja toodete väljatöötamist ning levikut.( http://www.ekre.ee/ekreprogramm/programm/loodushoid-ja-energeetika/)

Employment.english: The generation of tomorrow is our best project; therefore, the commitment of the Popular Party is to bring educational policies and training to develop the extraordinary potential of our youth and ensure stable environments that allow these young people to develop their life projects.
Employment.original:
Las generaciones futuras constituyen nuestro mejor proyecto; por ello, el compromiso del Partido Popular es llevar a cabo políticas educativas y de 
formación que desarrollen el extraordinario potencial de nuestros jóvenes y garantizar entornos estables que permitan a esos jóvenes desarrollar sus proyectos vitales.

Digital Revolution.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Political Participation.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Investing in Youth.english: Our priorities are  policies that stimulate economic growth and create jobs, with particular focus on creating opportunities for our youth, with initiatives such as the Youth Employment Plan, which was promoted by Spain to reduce the youth unemployment rate.
Investing in Youth.original: Nuestras prioridades son las políticas que estimulen el crecimiento económico y que generen empleo, con especial atención a la creación de oportunidades para nuestros jóvenes, con iniciativas como el Plan de Empleo Joven, impulsado por España con la finalidad de reducir la tasa de desempleo juven

Future of Europe.english: 1. Recognition of the need for an updated European strategy with regional  comprehensive strategies to help decision-making in security and defense , especially a maritime security strategy . 2. Preparing a possible reorganization of existing structures of management , in order to strengthen the level of integration between the military and civilian components. 3. Raising the terms of a possible agreement on the basic elements of a renewed resilience and a more effective strategic framework to facilitate the deployment of rapid response capabilities . 4. Advancing the process of capacity building and harmonization with NATO equivalent structures . 5 . Develop agreements and structures that allow the implementation of a broader range of capabilities. 6. Enhancing the industrial and technological base of the defense. 7. The harmonization of capacity development in European industrial policy with the definition and realization of the Common Security and Defence Policy.
Future of Europe.original:
1. El reconocimiento de la necesidad de una estrategia europea global yactualizada, así como el desarrollo de estrategias integrales temáticas yregionales que ayuden a la toma de decisiones en seguridad y defensa, especialmente la Estrategia de Seguridad marítima.
2. Preparar una posible reorganización de las estructuras de gestión decrisis existentes, con el fin de fortalecer el grado de integración entre los componentes militares y civiles.
3. Plantear los términos de un posible acuerdo sobre los elementos básicos de una renovada capacidad de reacción, así como un marco estratégico más eficaz destinado a facilitar el despliegue de los mecanismos y capacidades de Respuesta Rápida.
4. Avanzar en el proceso de desarrollo de capacidades y su armonización con las estructuras equivalentes en la OTAN.
5. Desarrollar acuerdos y estructuras que permitan la implementación de una gama más amplia de apacidades.
6. Potenciación de la base tecnológica e industrial de la defensa.
7. Todo ello con el compromiso de que el desarrollo en las capacidades yen la política industrial europea se armonice con el avance efectivo en la definición y concreción de la Política Común de Seguridad y Defensa

Environment.english: The Partido Popular will defend sensible and realistic policies in Europe that enhance our natural heritage and combat climate change. We will promote supportive measures to enhance the competitiveness of our industrial sector and an efficient energy policy, that promotes sustainable development and environmental protection
Environment.original:
_El Partido Popular defenderá en Europa una políticas edioambientales 
sensatas y realistas, que potencien nuestro patrimonio natural y que luchen de manera implacable contra el cambio climático. 
_Impulsaremos las medidas de apoyo que permitan recuperar la 
competitividad de nuestro Sector Industrial y una Política Energética eficiente, potenciando el desarrollo sostenible y la protección del medio ambiente,

Employment.english: We consider it relevant that the European Commission, through its EURES network, promote incentives for labour mobility of unemployed youth with an appropriate professional qualification.
Employment.original: empleo. Consideramos pertinente que la Comisión Europea, a través de su red EURES, promueva incentivos para la movilidad laboral de jóvenes desempleados con una cualificación profesional relevante.

Digital Revolution.english: We defend of the principle of net neutrality, guaranteeing the right of Internet users to share, receive or offer any flow of legitimate information through the internet, without  discrimination by providers of internet access, services and content. We support the development of an independent European electronic communications network, ensuring users' rights are safeguarded. Users should have  secure access to information, confidentiality and the privacy of using the Internet and other telecommunications media; and the protection of private data against individuals, companies and public and private entities.
Digital Revolution.original:
116 - Defensa del principio de neutralidad de la red, garantizando el derecho de los usuarios de internet a intercambiar, recibir u ofrecer cualquier flujo de información lícita a través de internet sin que pueda ser discriminado arbitrariamente por los prestadores de acceso, servicios y contenidos de internet.
117 - Apoyo al desarrollo de una red europea autónoma de comunicaciones electrónicas, garantizando a los usuarios una salvaguarda suficiente de sus derechos al acceso seguro a la información, la confidencialidad y la privacidad del uso de internet y de las telecomunicaciones, y de la protección de sus datos privados frente a particulares, empresas y entes públicos y privados.

Political Participation.english: To encourage the active participation of citizens in the future of the European Union, representing their legitimate interests and promoting European civic initiatives
Political Participation.original: Fomentar la participación activa de los ciudadanos de Europa en el progreso de la Unión, representando sus legítimos intereses y fomentando las iniciativas cívicas europeas

Investing in Youth.english: The future of the EU depends on 94 million Europeans aged between 15 and 29 years, of which in 2011 only 34% had a job, and with youth unemployment at 21%. Another group of 14 million young people, called "NINI" is excluded from the labour market and education, with enormous economic and social costs. In 2011, economic losses due to the failure of the youth labour market were estimated at €153,000 m (1.2% of the EU's GDP). It is essential to adopt specific European characteristics to promote youth employment, training "NINI" and integration into the labour market.
Investing in Youth.original: 89 - El futuro de la UE depende de 94 millones de europeos de entre 15 y 29 años, de los que en 2011 solo trabajaba el 34%, con un desempleo juvenil en 2011 del 21% (los estudiantes no se consideran población activa). Otro colectivo de 14 millones de jóvenes, los denominados “NINI”, está excluido del mercado laboral y de la educación, con enormes costes económicos y sociales. En 2011 se valoraron las pérdidas económicas debidas a la desvinculación de los jóvenes del mercado de trabajo en 153.000 m€ (1,2% PIB UE). Es imprescindible adoptar medidas específicas de carácter europeo para promover el empleo juvenil, la formación de los “NINI” y la integración en el mercado laboral.

Future of Europe.english: The EU has to promote peace and security, especially in the areas of Africa, the Middle East and Central and Eastern Europe - that affect the safety of its citizens and their interests. In these regions it should promote democratic values, compliance with UN resolutions , respect for human rights and sustainable development, encouraging the peaceful resolution of conflicts and regional integration, without ruling out the use of force to prevent serious violations of human rights or the establishment of terrorist regimes . Without a common foreign policy it is not possible to develop a European defence policy that, in turn, would need to have  common Defence Forces to be credible. Therefore, to deepen their common foreign policy and common defence involves developing common military capabilities.  But budget reductions seriously endanger the provision of an efficient defence that this new model entails.
Future of Europe.original: 41.- La UE ha de promover de manera especial la paz y la seguridad en aquellas zonas -principalmente África, Oriente Medio y Europa Central y del Este- que afectan a la seguridad de sus ciudadanos y de sus intereses, asumiendo mayores responsabilidades. Fomentará en dichas regiones los valores democráticos, el cumplimiento de las resoluciones de la ONU, el respeto de los derechos humanos y el desarrollo sostenible, promoviendo la resolución pacífica de conflictos y la integración regional, sin descartar el uso de la fuerza para impedir graves violaciones de los derechos humanos o la instauración de regímenes terroristas. (...) 42 - Sin una política exterior común no es posible desarrollar una política de defensa europea que, a su vez, necesitará contar con unas Fuerzas de Defensa comunes para resultar creíble. Por tanto, profundizar en la política exterior común y en la defensa común implica desarrollar capacidades militares comunes.(...) Pero la reducción de garantías presupuestarias que necesita ese nuevo modelo pone en grave peligro la disposición de una Defensa eficiente..

Environment.english: Energy should be cheap, competitive, stable, sustainable and available to all. We need a common energy policy for Europe with Energy Plans approved by the European Parliament, based on principles of increased competitiveness, common regulation, energy independence, connectivity between countries and regions, and freedom and transparency in the market. It is necessary to make progress in developing technological processes that are safer for citizens and the environment, by conducting research and maximizing the use of own resources, both renewable and not. Education should be improved and energy policy needs to be oriented towards promoting responsible consumption and savings, developing technologies that enable efficiency gains in homes and businesses.
Environment.original: 60 - La energía debe ser barata, competitiva, estable, sostenible y disponible para todos. Necesitamos una política energética común para toda Europa, con Planes Energéticos aprobados por el Parlamento Europeo, donde primen los conceptos de aumento de la competitividad, regulación común, independencia energética, conectividad entre los países y regiones, y libertad y transparencia del mercado. Es necesario avanzar en los procesos tecnológicos con mayor seguridad para los ciudadanos y el medio ambiente, investigando y maximizando el uso de todos los recursos propios, tanto los renovables como aquellos que no lo sean. (...). Debe reforzarse la educación y la política energética orientada a promover el consumo responsable y el ahorro, desarrollando las tecnologías que permiten ganancia de eficiencia en hogares y empresas

Employment.english: We will expand the participation of companies in vocational training, promoting joint projects of applied innovation to facilitate knowledge transfer between training centres and enterprises. We will promote the idea of shared campuses so that professional training is more interconnected with university studies and is able to establish a virtuous circle of learning and connection between centres, students and businesses. Shared campuses will encourage public-private partnerships, since companies need employees of different educational levels. From this environment we will also promote the entrepreneurial culture of the student-professional, thus saving costs in some common facilities (laboratories, kitchens, workshops, etc.).
Employment.original:
Ampliaremos la participación de las empresas en las acciones de formación profesional, promoviendo la realización conjunta de proyectos de innovación aplicada que faciliten la transferencia de conocimiento entre los centros formativos y las empresas.
-­‐ Promoveremos los campus compartidos para que la formación profesional esté más interconectada con los estudios universitarios y poder establecer un círculo virtuoso de aprendizaje y conexión entre los centros, los estudiantes y las empresas. Desde los campus compartidos se incentivaría la colaboración públicoprivada, puesto que las empresas necesitan trabajadores con diferentes niveles
educativos. Desde ese entorno también se fomentará la cultura emprendedora del
estudiante/profesional, con el consiguiente ahorro de costes en algunas
instalaciones comunes (laboratorios, cocinas, talleres, etc).

Digital Revolution.english: Some of the most severe risks facing the Union today are in the area of ​​rights and freedoms. These include: authoritarian tendencies observed in some member states; violations of rights of privacy and data protection; direct or indirect obstacles to the free movement of people;  the difficulties being experienced by the Schengen system; the policies adopted by some countries towards EU immigration; and the rise of nationalism and populism.
Digital Revolution.original: Algunos de los riesgos más intensos que afronta hoy la Unión se sitúan en el ámbito de los derechos y libertades. Las derivas autoritarias de no pocos estados miembros, las violaciones a los derechos de privacidad y protección de datos, las barreras directas o indirectas a la libre circulación de personas y las dificultades por las que atraviesa el sistema Schengen, las políticas que algunos países de la UE aplican a la inmigración, el ascenso de los nacionalismos y los populismos, figuran entre los más significativos

Political Participation.english: We will promote the necessary reforms so that the European Parliament has powers to initiate legislation to the same level as the European Commission. We will also promote the expansion of the powers of the European Parliament on economic and monetary matters and give stronger support to the  European Citizens' Initiative as an instrument of political participation.
Political Participation.original: Promoveremos las reformas necesarias para que el Parlamento Europeo cuente con poderes de iniciativa legislativa al mismo nivel que la Comisión Europea, así mismo promoveremos la ampliación de las competencias del Parlamento Europeo en el ámbito económico y monetario y daremos un impulso más decidido a la Iniciativa Ciudadana Europa como instrumento de participación política

Investing in Youth.english: Job creation for young people is a challenge that will define us for this and the next generation, and remains one of our key priorities. Therefore, we pledge to triple to €21,000 million  the current budget for the Youth Employment Guarantee and to expand it to cover people under 30 years of age.
Investing in Youth.original:
La creación de empleo para las y los jóvenes es un reto que nos definirá ante ésta y la próxima
generación, y seguirá siendo una de nuestras prioridades clave. Por ello, nos comprometemos a triplicar hasta los 21.000 millones de euros el presupuesto actual de la Garantía de Empleo Juvenil y a ampliarla para que abarque a las personas menores de 30 años.

Future of Europe.english: We as Socialists commit ourselves to working to bring coherence and consistency to the voice of the EU in the world, ensuring the principles underlying the external action of the Union. This is particularly pertinent insofar as it relates to development cooperation and the expression of European solidarity beyond its borders, which is a source of pride and must not be undermined by the economic crisis nor be affected by the austerity policies imposed by the right. Most of all, we will work to build a true European External Action servcie ensuring a strong and united voice in all the existing international organisations in which the European Union should be represented directly and not as a plurality of individual countries.
Future of Europe.original: Los socialistas nos comprometemos a trabajar para dar coherencia y consistencia a esa voz de la UE en el mundo, garantizando los principios que inspiran la acción exterior de la Unión especialmente en lo que se refiere a la cooperación para el desarrollo, expresión de la solidaridad europea más allá de sus fronteras de la que nos sentimos orgullosos y que no debe verse menoscabada por la crisis económica ni afectada por las políticas de austeridad impuestas por la derecha.(…)Y sobre todo, trabajaremos para construir una verdadera Acción Exterior Europea asegurando una única y fuerte voz en el conjunto de las organizaciones internacionales existentes en las que la Unión Europea debe aparecer como tal y no representada a través de una pluralidad de países individuales

Environment.english: One of the pillars of a new pattern of economic growth must be based on the principles of green economy and sustainable development. The EU must regain leadership in protecting the environment, natural resources, and in the fight against pollution and climate change. This requires leading by example and collaborating closely with other countries. We will support clean technologies and a sustainable production system, we will support more binding targets for increased use of renewable energy and increased energy efficiency. We will fight against energy poverty and guarantee a minimum access to energy for everyone. We will promote sustainable rural development to fight against inequality between rural and urban areas and will combat depopulation.
Environment.original: Uno de los pilares de un nuevo patrón de crecimiento económico debe estar basado en los principios de la economía verde y del desarrollo sostenible. La UE debe recuperar el liderazgo en la protección del medio ambiente, los recursos naturales, y en la lucha contra la contaminación y el cambio climático. Para ello es necesaria una estrecha colaboración con el resto de países y predicar con el ejemplo. Apoyaremos las tecnologías limpias y un sistema productivo sostenible, apoyaremos más objetivos vinculantes en relación con un mayor uso de las energías renovables y el aumento de la eficiencia energética. Lucharemos contra la pobreza energética y garantizaremos un acceso mínimo a la energía para todo el mundo. Potenciaremos un desarrollo rural sostenible que luche contra la desigualdad entre lo rural y lo urbano y combata la despoblación.

Employment.english: Elimination of the contractual status of unpaid work and the introduction of a full wage to be paid to the worker as if it were a casual or fixed rate contract. Elimination of the status of intern, replacing this status with that of worker with full rights. At the same time intensify the monitoring of labour to limit the use of grants as a replacement for jobs and punish those public agencies and private companies that continue to use this status. Require all public bodies and private companies to hire at least 5% of workers under the age of 31, provided that it is not necessary to dismiss casual or fixed rate company staff.
Employment.original: − Eliminación de la figura contractual de prácticas no remuneradas y obligación de percepción del salario completo que le correspondería al trabajador o trabajadora en prácticas como si fuera un eventual o un fijo. − Eliminación de la figura del becario/becaria, teniendo esta figura que ser reemplazada por la de trabajadoras/es de pleno derecho. Aumentar mientras la inspección laboral para limitar la utilización de las becascomo sustitución de puestos de trabajo y sancionar a aquellos organismos públicos y empresas privadas que sigan utilizando esta figura. − Exigir a todas los organismos públicos y empresas privadas la contratación de un 5% de trabajadoras/es menores de 31 años, siempre que para contratar no sea necesario despedir a personal eventual o fijo de empresa.

Digital Revolution.english: European legislation must be passed that guarantees the neutrality of the net and of networks. It needs to define the role of companies that provide support, and ensure that the services provided do not distinguish or prioritise in an arbitrary manner content, services, applications or anything else, based on criteria such as ownership, brand, source of origin or preferences.
Digital Revolution.original: Por ello deberá aprobarse una legislación europea que garantice la neutralidad de la red y de las redes delimitando el papel de las empresas que proveen el soporte a la comunicación y garantizando que el servicio que ofrezcan los prestadores de los servicios no distinga ni priorice de modo arbitrario contenido, servicios, aplicaciones u otros basándose en criterios de propiedad, marca, fuente de origen o preferencia.

Political Participation.english: Extend citizenship rights to non-EU residents on a par with EU residents, especially the right to vote and to stand in elections, as a key element of participation and integration into the country of residence. Establish a minimum voting age of 16 for all types of elections in the Union. Adopt European legislation with a view to integrating it in the regulatory framework of all European and national representative structures in order to ensure a membership quota of at least 15% of young people under the age of 30 years in these structures.
Political Participation.original: − Extender los derechos de ciudadanía a los residentes no comunitarios y especialmente el derecho de sufragio activo y pasivo, en igualdad con los comunitarios, como elemento fundamental de participación e integración en el país de residencia.  − Establecer la edad mínima para poder ejercer el voto a los 16 años para cualquier tipo de elecciones en los estados de la Unión.  − La aprobación de una normativa europea que se itegre en los reglamentos de todas las estructuras de representación europea y estatales, que asegure al menos, una presencia de un 15% de jóvenes entre los y las miembros menores de 30 años.

Investing in Youth.english:
The minimum wage for those under thirty years of age should be based on criteria that include aspects such as: the average staple food consumption needed to support a person for a month, and the average rent of a home of 40 m2. There is a need to promote the incorporation of youth in the job market with job sharing,  early retirement, reduction of  working hours and encouraging relief contracts.
Measures are also required to end the scam of  financial assistance that is aimed at youth employment ends up being effectively an injection of public money to finance subsidies to private companies.
Investing in Youth.original:
Salario mínimo interprofesional para menores de 30 años basado en criterio de precios que incluya aspectos como: el consumo alimenticio básico medio necesario para mantener a una persona durante un mes y el precio medio de alquiler de una vivienda de 40 m2.
− Potenciar la incorporación de la juventud al empleo y el reparto de trabajo mediante el adelanto de la edad de jubilación, la reducción de la jornada laboral y el fomento de los contratos de relevo(…) 
− Medidas para acabar con la estafa que supone que las ayudas económicas que van destinadas al empleo juvenil acaben luego siendo, en realidad, una inyección de dinero público para financiar bonificaciones a empresas privadas

Future of Europe.original:
La UE no es un actor de paz, sino que alienta el rearme de los Estados miembros y ni está ni se le espera en iniciativas que conduzcan a la democratización de las Naciones Unidas, la paz, el desarme y el incremento sustancial de la cooperación para poner fin al hambre y la pobreza, armas de destrucción masiva por excelencia.
Desde Izquierda Unida nos comprometemos a cambiar sustancialmente la actual Política Exterior y de Vecindad de la UE. Ésta debe basarse en la paz, el desarme, la cooperación y las relaciones internacionales democráticas. (...)Proponemos la realización de una Convención Internacional para el Desarme que concrete:
− Prohibición y destrucción ecológica de todo el arsenal de armas de destrucción masiva ABQ
− La reducción drástica de programas industriales e I+D armamentistas hasta llegar a 0.
− La aplicación rigurosa del código de Conducta en material de Exportación de Armas.
− La prevención diplomática de los conflictos, la renuncia a la guerra.

Environment.english: There is a need to correct trade imbalances and disparities in production structures to allow for a sustainable re-industrialisation process in the economies of the southern periphery. The momentum of the industrialisation process must hinge on two core elements: the type of industry, which should be based on sustainable sectors (e.g. the renewable energy sector in which Spain is a pioneer) and the participation of workers in the ownership and management of these. We need to establish a green tax that not only has revenue objectives but serves to discourage any business model that has a strongly negative impact on the environment . The EU should consider natural resources as the property of mankind, and therefore not subject to exploitation or to intellectual property rights and patents.
Environment.original:
La necesidad de corregir los desequilibrios comerciales y las disparidades en las estructuras productivas pasan por poner en marcha un proceso de reindustrialización sostenible en las economías de la periferia del sur.El impulso del proceso de industrialización deberá orbitar sobre dos elementos centrales: el tipo de industria
(atenderá a criterios de demanda) que deberá basarse en sectores sostenibles (por ejemplo las energías renovables sector en el que España es pionera) y la participación de los trabajadores y trabajadoras en la propiedady gestión de las mismas.(…)creemos necesario el establecimiento de una fiscalidad verde que no sólo tenga objetivos recaudatorios sino que sirva para desincentivar cualquier modelo de negocio que tenga fuertes implicaciones negativas sobre el medio ambiente. (…) La UE debe considerar los recursos naturales como bienes de la humanidad, por lo que no pueden estar sujetos a sobreexplotación ni a los derechos de propiedad intelectual y las patentes.

Employment.english: Many young people today  completely give up because they cannot get an internship. We are going to need  skilled labour in the future. SF will therefore ensure internships for all young people.
Employment.original: Mange unge må i dag helt opgive at blive færdiguddannet (...) fordi de ikke kan få en praktikplads. (...) Vi kommer til at mangle den uddannede arbejdskraft i fremtiden. SF vil derfor sikre praktikpladser til alle unge. http://www.sf.dk/politik/politikomraader/uddannelse

Digital Revolution.english: The extensive oversight of  citizens' internet and telephone traffic should be replaced ordinary secrecy, the right to communicate and move freely, and proportionality should be reintroduced into the authorities' access to personal data.
Digital Revolution.original: Den omfattende overvågning af alle borgeres internet og tele-trafik skal erstattes af en tilstand, der genindfører almindelig brevhemmelighed, retten til at kommunikere og færdes frit, og der skal genindføres proportionalitet i myndigheders adgang til persondata. EP valgprogram side 4.

Political Participation.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Investing in Youth.english: The European Youth Guarantee means that all young people in Europe will receive an offer of education, training, upgrading, internship or a job after four months of unemployment.
Investing in Youth.original: En europæisk ungdomsgaranti, som betyder, at alle unge i Europa efter 4 måneders ledighed modtager et relevant og kvalitetsfyldt tilbud om uddannelse, efteruddannelse, opkvalificering, praktik eller job. EP valgprogram side 3.

Future of Europe.english: The Lisbon Treaty has given the European Parlament new powers in the foreign policy area, and the Parlament must exploit these to the fullest in order to create a strong and coherent common European foreign policy based on democracy, human rights, international law and the rule of law.
Future of Europe.original: Lissabon-traktaten har givet Europa-Parlamentet nye beføjelser på det udenrigspolitiske område, og det skal Parlamentet udnytte til fulde for at skabe en stærk og sammenhængende fælles europæisk udenrigspolitik, der bygger på demokrati, menneskerettigheder, Folkeretten og retsstatsprincipperne. EP valgprogram side 5.

Environment.english: A green transformation in Europe will create a better society, provide real solutions to global challenges and create new sustainable growth and jobs.
Environment.original: En grøn omstilling i Europa vil skabe et bedre samfund, levere konkrete løsninger på de globale udfordringer og skabe ny holdbar vækst og arbejdspladser. EP valgprogram side 3.

Employment.english: The struggle against the alarming high youth unemployment should be intensified at the European level. Countries must focus strongly on young peoples' education, internships and easier access to the labour market.
Employment.original: Kampen mod den alarmerende høje ungdomsarbejdsløshed skal styrkes på europæisk plan (... )herunder at landende massivt satser på unges uddannelse, praktiskpladser og nemmere adgang til arbejdsmarkedet" (EU-valgprogram: s.3)

Digital Revolution.english: As consumers, we should have better security when we buy on the internet. Likewise, we should have high standards of personal data security.
Digital Revolution.original: "Som forbrugere skal vi have større tryghed, når vi handler på nettet, ligesom vi skal have høje standarder for personlig databeskyttelse" (EU-valgprogram: p.11)

Political Participation.english: It is important for us that the distance between each citizen and the  EU is reduced, so that citizens can influence and obtain ownership of changes at the European level.
Political Participation.original: Det er for os vigtigt at afstanden mellem den enkelte borger og EU mindskes, så borgeren kan få mulighed for at påvirke og få et ejerskab til de ændringer som sker på det europæiske niveau. (EU-valgprogram: s. 11)

Investing in Youth.english: The struggle against the alarmingly high youth unemployment rate should be intensified at the European level.
Investing in Youth.original: "Kampen mod den alarmerende høje ungdomsarbejdsløshed skal styrkes på europæisk plan..." (EU-valgprogram: s.3)

Future of Europe.english: The Social Democrats want the EU to intensify actions against global poverty and inequality.
Future of Europe.original: Socialdemokraterne ønsker, at EU fremover intensiverer sin indsats for at bekæmpeglobal fattigdom og ulighed. (EU-valgprogram: s. 13)

Environment.english: The Social Democrats fight for a greener EU. Denmark should use its influence in the EU to increase the level of ambition for the European enviromental, energy and climate policies.
Environment.original: Socialdemokraterne kæmper for et grønnere EU. Danmark skal bruge sin indflydelse i EU til at hæve ambitionsniveauet for den europæiske miljø-, energi- og klimapolitik. (EU-valgprogram: s. 9)

Employment.english: Small and medium-sized enterprises account for 67%  of all jobs in Europe and there is significant growth potential. We must make it possible for these companies to help drive innovation forward and create the products and services that will be our future livelihood.
Employment.original: Små og mellemstore virksomheder står for 67 pct. af alle arbejdspladser i Europa og indeholder et stort vækstpotentiale. Vi skal gøre det muligt for dem at være med til at drive innovationen frem, og skabe de produkter og services der bliver fremtidens levebrød. (http://www.konservative.dk/Personer/B/Bendt-Bendtsen/Nyheder/Innovation-i-det-smaa#sthash.GNr59ZhT.dpuf)

Digital Revolution.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Political Participation.english: The leading figures of the Commission and the Council should continue to be elected by the heads of EU’s states and governments. This is in line with the fact that the EU is a cooperation between independent states Therefore the Conservative People's Party does not support a presidential election to the Commission that pretends to solve a problem of democracy.
Political Participation.original: De ledende skikkelser i Kommissionen og Ministerrådet skal også fremover vælges af EU’s stats- og regeringschefer, da dette er i overensstemmelse med, at EU er et samarbejde mellem selvstændige lande. Det Konservative Folkeparti støtter derfor ikke et præsidentvalg til Kommissionen, der foregiver at løse et demokratisk problem uden reel mulighed for at tage hensyn til de forskellige befolkningers ønsker.

Investing in Youth.english: The global economic crisis, and the debt problems in the eurozone, have made ​​it clear that the EU countries for years to come will have to focus on creating growth, jobs and healthy public finances to gain control over their deficits.
Investing in Youth.original: Den økonomiske krise i verden og gældsproblemerne i eurolandene har gjort det klart, at EU-landene i mange år fremover skal have fokus stift rettet mod netop at skabe vækst, job og en sund offentlig økonomi for at få styr på gælden. (Det Konservative Folkeparti, EU-Program: 3)

Future of Europe.english: Foreign policy is and remains a national matter. The European External Action Service may contribute positively to a wide range of areas that could benefit Denmark and Danish business sector. Among other things, by ensuring that the EU speaks with a stronger voice on the world stage, including  to authoritarian regimes, and also to emerging economies with their growing economic and political influence.
Future of Europe.original: Udenrigspolitik er og bliver et nationalt anliggende. EU’s udenrigstjeneste kan dog bidrage positivt på en lang række områder, som kan gavne Danmark og dansk erhvervsliv.Blandt andet ved at sikre, at EU taler med en stærkere stemme på den globale scene, herunder i forhold til autoritære regimer, men også i forhold til de nye vækstøkonomier og deres voksende økonomiske og politiske indflydelse. (Det Konservative Folkeparti, EU-program: 10)

Environment.english: Such policies are based on respect for nature and climate, and also because we do not want Denmark to be dependent on unstable or uncooperative regimes. When we develop policies in this area, it should always be done in partnership with business, so that we ensure optimum solutions for all parties.
Environment.original: Det skyldes både hensynet til natur og klima, men også fordi vi ønsker, at Danmark ikke skal være afhængig af ustabile eller usamarbejdsvillige regimer. Når vi udvikler politik på dette område, skal det altid ske i samspil med erhvervslivet, så vi sikrer optimale løsninger for alle parter (Det Konservative Folkeparti, Parti Program: 32).

Employment.english: The domains of research and education  should focus on exchange and cooperation.
Employment.original: Forsknings- og uddannelsesområdet bør have fokus på udveksling og samarbejde. (Liberal Alliance, Arbejdsprogram: 12)

Digital Revolution.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Political Participation.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Investing in Youth.english: Both the government and the opposition are beating down on the young unemployed in the press. They say there are no free rides, and that all must show responsibility and a sense of duty. If there is work, the unemployed should of course take it - even though they may believe they are overqualified. But the real problem is, of course, recent last year’s incoherent tax and economic policies that have destroyed Denmark's competitiveness and made up to 200,000 Danes unemployed.
Investing in Youth.original: Både S-SF-R og VKO tæsker løs på de unge arbejdsløse i pressen. Der er ingen fribilletter –– alle må vise ansvar og pligtfølelse, siger man. Hvis der er et arbejde, skal man naturligvis tage det –– også selv om man måske mener, man er overkvalificeret. Ingen tvivl om det. Men det virkelige problem er jo, at de sidste mange års kiksede skatte- og erhvervspolitik har ødelagt Danmarks konkurrenceevne og gjort op mod 200.000 danskere arbejdsløse. (https://www.liberalalliance.dk/sites/default/files/syndebuk_tabloid_final.pdf)

Future of Europe.english: The Liberal Alliance supports Danish participation in the EU, UN, NATO and the WTO. However, we believe that Denmark should work to ensure that these organisations engage only in their original areas: peace, security and free trade.
Future of Europe.original: Liberal Alliance er tilhængere af dansk deltagelse i EU, FN, NATO og WTO. Dog mener vi, at Danmark bør arbejde for, at disse organisationer besinder sig på deres oprindelige udgangspunkt: fred, sikkerhed og frihandel. (Liberal Alliance, Arbejdsprogram 2013: 11)

Environment.english: Denmark should focus on rational energy-saving and climate adaptations, rather than a costly restructuring of the economy, which favours  selected fossil-free energy sources, which do not necessarily have a positive effect on the environment.
Environment.original: Danmark bør koncentrere sig om rationelle energibesparelser og klimatilpasninger frem for en kostbar omlægning af økonomien, som favoriserer særligt udvalgte fossilfrie energiformer, og som ikke nødvendigvis har nogen særlig positiv effekt på miljøet (Liberal Alliance, Arbejdsprogram 2013: 16).

Digital Revolution.english: Surveillance is a significant violation of  EU citizens' rights and should be stopped immediately.
Digital Revolution.original: Dette er en vigtig undersøgelse, som fastslår, at overvågning er et alvorligt brud på EU-borgernes rettigheder og bør øjeblikkeligt stoppes (Måske no opinion?)

Political Participation.english: The movement of decisions away from the forums with democratic legitimacy, the national forums included, must stop. A union whose principal purpose is to secure the free movement of goods in an internal market, and where  individuals are subject to the same dictates of the market, can never become a foundation for a democracy capable of survival.
Political Participation.original: Det skal være slut med at flytte de demokratiske beslutninger væk fra de fora, der har demokratisk legitimitet, herunder de nationale. En union, hvis væsentligste formål er at sikre varens fri bevægelighed inden for et indre marked, og hvor menneskene underlægges samme markeds diktater, kan aldrig blive et fundament for et levedygtigt demokrati

Investing in Youth.english: 26 million people have been thrown out of work. In some countries, more than half of young people are out of work. And not least because of the tough EU-dictated austerity measures.
Investing in Youth.original: 26 millioner er blevet kastet ud i arbejdsløshed. I nogle lande står over halvdelen af de unge uden arbejde. Og dette ikke mindst på grund af den benhårde EU-dikterede nedskæringspolitik

Future of Europe.english: The work of the People's Movement in the EU Parlament always takes as its starting point our main ambition: to prevent the EU from gaining more powers.
Future of Europe.original: Folkebevægelsens arbejde i EU-parlamentet tager altid udgangspunkt i vores hovedmål: at hindre EU i at få mere magt

Environment.english: If our children and grandchildren are to have proper life chances, action must be taken against the threats to the environment, and climate problems, both at a European and at an international level.
Environment.original: Hvis vores børn og børnebørn skal sikres et ordentligt liv, må der gribes ind overfor de truende miljø- og klimaproblemer, både på nationalt, på europæisk og på internationalt plan

Employment.english: Danish educational institutions should use and expand the opportunities for exchange and internship abroad through the EU's educational programmes. Such programmes include  vocational education, further and higher education and other education - in order to strengthen  students' international skills and the quality of  education.
Employment.original: Danske uddannelsesinstitutioner skal gøre brug af og udbygge mulighederne for udveksling og studie-/praktikophold i udlandet gennem EU’s uddannelsesprogrammer for erhvervs-, videregående og andre uddannelser for at styrke den studerendes internationale kompetencer og kvaliteten af uddannelserne

Digital Revolution.english: EU citizens should feel just as secure trading on the internet in the rest of the EU as in their own country.
Digital Revolution.original: EU-borgere skal være lige så trygge ved at handle på nettet i resten af EU som i deres hjemland.

Political Participation.english: Venstre wants an EU that has effective institutions which ensure that right goes before might, so larger countries and companies cannot dominate others because of their sheer size. The EU’s administration must be transparent. The principle of subsidiarity must be respected so that decisions are made as close to the citizens.
Political Participation.original: Grundlæggende synes jeg, det er en fantastisk idé [præsidentvalg til Kommissionen]. Lige præcis dette spørgsmål tror jeg vil kunne få danskerne med på en europapolitisk dagsorden, og det er derfor, jeg personligt har talt varmt for denne idé

Investing in Youth.english:
Unfortunately, the EU is lagging behind other economies, such as Japan and the United States, and runs the risk of being overtaken by future strong contenders such as India and China. This trend must be reversed if we 
are not to fail the more than five million young unemployed in the EU.
Investing in Youth.original:
Desværre halter Europa efter andre udviklede økonomier såsom USA 
og Japan og risikerer snart at blive overhalet af fremtidens stærke spillere som Kina og Indien. Det 
skal der laves om på, inden vi taber de over 5 millioner unge arbejdsløse i EU på gulvet.

Future of Europe.english:
A world with new super-powers, new threats and a Europe which is losing influence demands that the 
European states strengthen EU defence and security policies.
Future of Europe.original:
En verden med nye stormagter, nye trusler og et Europa, der mister indflydelse, kræver, at de 
europæiske lande styrker EU’s forsvars- og sikkerhedspolitik

Environment.english: When it is appropriate, environmental duties can be applied to certain products. The environmental duties must have a positive effect on the environment, which is why the duties should mirror the  strains on society caused by the production and consumption of the products in question.
Environment.original: Hvor det er hensigtsmæssigt, kan der indføres miljøafgifter på visse produkter. Miljøafgifter skal virke positivt på miljøet, hvorfor disse bør afspejle den samfundsmæssige belastning ved produktion og forbrug af de pågældende produkter.

Employment.english: The Danish People's party wants heightened cooperation between educational institutions and business. The responsibility is  two-way: educational institutions must ensure that education  corresponds and complies with the needs of business and industry. In addition,  businesses must provide internships and participate in  professional awareness programmes along with the educational institutions.
Employment.original:
"Dansk Folkeparti vil arbejde for et forstærket samarbejde mellem uddannelsesinstitutioner
og erhvervsliv. Ansvaret går begge veje: Skoler og uddannelsesinstitutioner skal
sørge for, at uddannelserne er tidssvarende og i overensstemmelse med erhvervslivets
krav, og erhvervslivet skal på sin side sørge for praktikpladser og deltage i faglige
oplysningsprojekter med uddannelsesinstitutionerne." Kilde: http://www.danskfolkeparti.dk/B%C3%B8rn___ungepolitik

Digital Revolution.english: ISPs should be required to set up more filters to prevent hackers and spam from entering both private and public IT systems.
Digital Revolution.original: "Internetudbydere må pålægges i stadig højere grad at opsætte filtre, som forhindrer hackere og spam i at komme ind på både private og offentlige IT-anlæg."

Political Participation.english: Political developments in  European countries are characterised by a widening distance between the people and its politicians. By claiming that the problems of today are too large and complex for the ordinary citizen to understand, the elites are increasingly trying to weaken the citizens' direct influence over their own society.
Political Participation.original: "Den politiske udvikling i de europæiske lande er kendetegnet af en voksende afstand mellem befolkningen og politikerne. Samfundenes magteliter søger i stigende grad at svække borgernes direkte indflydelse på deres samfund, idet eliterne påberåber sig, at nutidens problemer er for store og sammensatte til, at almindelige borgere kan overskue dem" Kilde: http://www.danskfolkeparti.dk/Den_Europ%C3%A6iske_Union

Investing in Youth.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Future of Europe.english: The Danish People's Party supports  coordinated cooperation between the EU countries and the USA with the goal of fighting terrorism and international crime.   However, the military safety of Europe can  be secured only through NATO.
Future of Europe.original: "Dansk Folkeparti er tillige tilhænger af et koordineret samarbejde mellem EU-landene og USA om bekæmpelse af terrorisme og international kriminalitet." men også "Europas militære sikkerhed kan alene sikres gennem NATO-samarbejdet." Kilde: http://www.danskfolkeparti.dk/Den_Europ%C3%A6iske_Union

Environment.english: Thus, the goal is qualitative growth, which - put simply - means that the goal is not simply to produce more, but to produce better. This includes developing products that can help foster sustainable growth - both outside the industrialised countries as well as inside them.
Environment.original: "Målet er således kvalitativ vækst, hvilket forenklet udtrykt betyder, at målet ikke bare er at producere mere, men at producere bedre, herunder at udvikle produkter, som ved anvendelse på verdensplan kan medvirke til at skabe en bæredygtig udvikling også uden for industrilandene" Kilde: http://www.danskfolkeparti.dk/Rent_milj%C3%B8

Employment.english: It is of the utmost importance that the problems concerning internships are solved; preferably through new types of cooperation, and by giving more help to young people in need of an internship.
Employment.original:
"Det er helt centralt, at praktikpladsproblematikken løses; gerne gennem mulighed for nye 
typer samarbejder, og ved at de unge får yderligere støtte til at finde praktikpladser" Kilde: http://www.radikale.dk/system/files/Dokumenter/Programmer_Uddannelse_Marts2012.pdf

Digital Revolution.english: We need to lower the roaming charges.
Digital Revolution.original: "Endelig skal vi sætte roaming-afgifterne yderligere ned, (...)." Kilde: http://www.b.dk/politiko/digital-tidsalder-kraever-digitalt-indre-marked

Political Participation.english: Legislation in Brussels can appear distant for many Danes. Therefore, it is important that  national politicians, officials, opinion leaders and  media engage themselves and focus more on the European political system.
Political Participation.original: "Lovgivningsarbejdet i Bruxelles kan virke fjernt for mange danskere. Derfor er det vigtigt, at folkevalgte, embedsmænd, meningsdannere og medier på nationalt niveau engagerer sig i og fokuserer mere på det europæiske politiske system" Kilde: http://ep-valg.radikale.dk/content/ansvar-europa-ansvar-danmark

Investing in Youth.english: Therefore EU needs to create the belief of a brighter future (...) for the young that have not gotten a chance to finding a foothold in the labor market"
Investing in Youth.original: "Derfor skal EU her og nu bidrage til at skabe en tro på en bedre fremtid (...) for de unge, som endnu ikke har fået en chance for at finde fodfæste på arbejdsmarkedet." Kilde: http://ep-valg.radikale.dk/content/ansvar-europa-ansvar-danmark

Future of Europe.english: When the EU speaks with one voice, our opinions hold great weight on the international stage. Therefore, the Danish Social Liberal Party will work towards improved coordination of foreign policy, and wants the EU to continue to be at the forefront in the fight for peace, democracy, human rights and equal opportunities for all.
Future of Europe.original: Når EU står sammen, taler vi med stor vægt på den internationale scene (...). Derfor vil Radikale Venstre arbejde for en langt tættere koordination af udenrigspolitikken, og vi vil have som mål, at EU vedbliver med at være frontløber i kampen for fred, demokrati, menneskerettigheder og muligheder for alle." Kilde: http://www.radikale.dk/content/eu

Environment.english: The need for a transition to sustainable growth puts  new requirements on Danish and European industry's innovation and competitiveness.
Environment.original: "(...)behovet for omstilling til en bæredygtig udvikling (...) sætter nye krav til dansk og europæisk erhvervslivs innovations- og konkurrenceevne" Kilde: http://ep-valg.radikale.dk/content/ansvar-europa-ansvar-danmark

Employment.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Digital Revolution.english: We want a functioning digital internal market.
Digital Revolution.original: "Haluamme toimivat digitaaliset sisämarkkinat." (http://www.kokoomus.fi/assets/2012-eurooppa-huomenna-grahn-laasonen-wallinheimo.pdf, p. 10)

Political Participation.english: We want a more political union where decisions are arrived at together. The problem of the European Unions is, paradoxically, that it is not political enough. Trust in the European Union and its decision-making can be strengthen only if democracy in the EU increases.
Political Participation.original: "Haluamme poliittisemman unionin, jossa asioista päätetään yhdessä. Euroopan unionin ongelma on – hassua kyllä –, että se ei ole tarpeeksi poliittinen. -- Luottamus Euroopan unionia ja sen päätöksentekoa kohtaan voi vahvistua vain, jos kansanvalta EU:ssa kasvaa." (http://www.kokoomus.fi/assets/2012-eurooppa-huomenna-grahn-laasonen-wallinheimo.pdf, pp. 3, 14)

Investing in Youth.english: Special attention should be paid to youth unemployment. We cannot lose the young permanently from the world of unemployment because of the global recession!
Investing in Youth.original: "Nuorisotyöttömyyteen on kiinnitettävä erityinen huomio. Emme saa menettää nuoria pysyvästi työelämästä kansainvälisen taantuman vuoksi!" (https://www.kokoomus.fi/jyrkin-paivakirja/tulevaisuuden-tyo/)

Future of Europe.english: To strengthen its position in global politics, the EU should be represented by one voice. The EU should develop its policies, as part of its global role, on how Europe can succeed in the increasingly competitive global environment and, at the same time and based on its values, the EU could influence the direction in which the world is developing. The principal areas in which to attempt to influence direction are an open and functioning  economy and environmental issues.
Future of Europe.original: "Vahvistaakseen maailmanpoliittisen asemansa EU:n tulee esiintyä yhdellä äänellä.  -- Seuraavaa ideaa EU:n tulisi etsiä globaalista roolistaan – miten Eurooppa voisi menestyä parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla kiristyvässä globaalissa kilpailussa ja toisaalta siitä, miten EU voisi mahdollisimman vahvasti arvojensa pohjalta vaikuttaa siihen, mihin suuntaan maailma kehittyy. Näitä vaikuttamisen paikkoja ovat esimerkiksi avoin ja toimiva maailmantalous, ihmisoikeudet sekä ympäristökysymykset." (http://www.kokoomus.fi/assets/2012-eurooppa-huomenna-grahn-laasonen-wallinheimo.pdf, pp. 7, 15)

Environment.english: We want Europe to be the leader in climate and environmtal goals and the number one in green growth. We cannot afford to give up on this fight if we wish to leave oxygen, a clean climate and a liveable planet Earth for our children.
Environment.original:
"Haluamme, että Eurooppa on ilmasto- ja ympäristötavoitteiden esitaistelija ja vihreän kasvun ykkönen. -- Meillä ei ole varaa haudata tätä taistelua, jos haluamme jättää lapsillemme happea,
puhdasta vettä ja elinkelpoisen maapallon." (http://www.kokoomus.fi/assets/2012-eurooppa-huomenna-grahn-laasonen-wallinheimo.pdf, p. 11)

Employment.english: A culture of entrepreneurship should be encouraged in higher education. There is no reason to be satisfied with new innovations mainly stemming from Silicon Valley in the US or technological applications from the Far East.
Employment.original: "Korkeakoulujen ympärille on rohkaistava yrittämisen kulttuuria. Ei ole syytä tyytyä tai alistua siihen, että uusia uria aukovat innovaatiot kumpuavat Yhdysvaltain piilaaksoista tai teknologiset sovellutukset kaukaa idästä." (http://www.sdp.fi/images/tiedostot/nakemys_euroopasta.pdf, p. 8)

Digital Revolution.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Political Participation.english: The EU should be there for the citizens of Europe. That requires that the citizens and the organisations that represent them should be better taken into account and their opportunities for participation in the EU should be increased.  New proposals for repairing the democratic deficit are welcome.
Political Participation.original: "EU:n tulee olla myös kansalaisten Eurooppa. Se edellyttää kansalaisten ja heitä edustavien järjestöjen nykyistä parempaa kuulemista ja osallistumismahdollisuuksia EU:ssa. Uudet esitykset demokratiavajeen korjaamiseksi ovat tervetulleita." (http://www.sdp.fi/images/tiedostot/nakemys_euroopasta.pdf, p. 8)

Investing in Youth.english: There should be zero tolerance for youth unemployment.  We want to strengthen the resources of employment policy so that either employment, or a place in education or an apprenticeship can be guaranteed for every young person after 3 months of unemployment.
Investing in Youth.original: "Nuorisotyöttömyydelle on asetettava nollatoleranssi. -- Haluamme vahvistaa työvoimapolitiikan resursseja siten, että jokaiselle nuorelle voidaan taata työ-, koulutus- tai harjoittelupaikka viimeistään 3kk työttömyyden alkamisesta." (http://www.sdp.fi/fi/component/content/article/62-sdp/tutustu/arvot/politiikan-a-oe/4442-politiikan-a-o)

Future of Europe.english: The foreign policy of the Union is built upon its values, international treaties and the furtherance of global common responsibility. The EU should be able to take on a global role in questions relating to the economy, climate, development and security.
Future of Europe.original: "Unionin ulkopolitiikka rakentuu sen arvopohjan, kansainvälisten sopimusten ja globaalin yhteisvastuun edistämisen varaan. EU:n pitää pystyä ottamaan globaali roolinsa niin talous-, ilmasto-, kehitys-, kuin turvallisuuspolitiikankin kysymyksissä." (http://ohjelmatyo.sdp.fi/2012/11/27/nakemys-euroopasta/)

Political Participation.english: The citizens should be better listened to in the Union and neither integration nor the development of the EU can be increased while ignoring  popular opinion. In particular. the democracy of the European Commission should be developed. This can happen, for example, by creating national, country-specific voting systems to select the Commissioners.
Political Participation.original: "Unionissa on kuunneltava kansalaisia paremmin, eikä yhdentymistä tai EU:n kehittämistä voida jatkaa kansalaismielipiteestä välittämättä. Erityisesti EU-komission demokraattisuutta on kehitettävä. Tämä voi tapahtua esimerkiksi luomalla äänestysjärjestelmä komissaarien valitsemiseksi kansallisissa, maakohtaisissa vaaleissa." (http://www.perussuomalaiset.fi/eu-vaaliohjelma/)

Future of Europe.english: The EU should be reformed to become less bureaucratic.
Future of Europe.original: "EU:ta on uudistettava vähemmän byrokraattiseen suuntaan." (http://www.perussuomalaiset.fi/eu-vaaliohjelma/)

Environment.english: The EU should ensure the competitiveness of its industries as a matter of urgency. Minimising emissions is the priority in environmental policy. However, this goal will not be  realised by carbon trading and the quantitative reduction of emissions.
Environment.original: "EU:n tulee kaikin keinoin pitää kiinni teollisuutensa kilpailukyvystä. --Ilmastopolitiikassa päästöjen minimointi on päätavoite. Päästökauppajärjestelmällä ja määrällisellä päästötavoitteiden pienenemisellä tama tavoite ei kuitenkaan toteudu mielekkäästi." (http://www.perussuomalaiset.fi/eu-vaaliohjelma/)

Employment.english: Furthering entrepreneurship is an important focal point  in education policy. It is essential to enhance positive attitudes towards entrepreneurial and innovative activities. Thus the entrepreneurship programme has facilitated youth entrepreneurship.
Employment.original: Yrittäjyyden edistäminen on tärkeä painopiste myös koulutuspolitiikassa. -- Oleellista on uuden yritys- ja innovaatiotoiminnan edistämiseen liittyvä asennekasvatus. Lisäksi yrittäjyysohjelmalla on edistetty nuorten yrittäjäksi ryhtymistä." (https://www.keskusta.fi/Suomeksi/Politiikka/Keskustan-politiikka-A-O#a)

Digital Revolution.english: Nation wide, sufficiently fast and reasonably priced information networks are a prerequisite for a functioning country. Keskusta believes it is importan,t on the grounds of regional equality, that Internet connections are available to all Finns at a similar price.
Digital Revolution.original: "Koko maan kattavat, riittävän nopeat ja kohtuuhintaiset tietoliikenneyhteydet ovat maaseudun yksi elinehto --. Keskusta pitää alueellisen tasa-arvon kannalta tärkeänä, että internet-yhteydet saadaan kaikkien suomalaisten ulottuville yhtäläiseen hintatasoon." (https://www.keskusta.fi/Suomeksi/Politiikka/Keskustan-politiikka-A-O#l)

Investing in Youth.english: In the 2008 budget the Cabinet decided to redirect funds, originally targeted at a low-wage support scheme, into preventing social exclusion and improving employment opportunities for  youth. The increase of funds has been directed towards, among other things, workshop activities, widening of apprenticeship schemes, wage support for youths and employment for those with  handicaps.
Investing in Youth.original: "Vuoden 2008 budjetin yhteydessä hallitus päätti suunnata matalapalkkatukikokeiluun alun perin varattuja määrärahoja erityisesti nuorten syrjäytymiskehityksen ehkäisemiseksi ja työllistymismahdollisuuksien parantamiseksi. Määrärahojen lisäykset on suunnattu muun muassa nuorten työpajatoimintaan, oppisopimuskoulutuksen laajentamiseen, nuorten palkkatukeen samoin kuin vajaakuntoisten työllistämiseen." (https://www.keskusta.fi/Suomeksi/Politiikka/Keskustan-politiikka-A-O#n)

Future of Europe.english: The Union should further peace and democracy, equality and the fulfilment of human rights. The rights of children and efforts to ensure authoritarian regimes are not strengthened by development aid, should be particular areas for change. The EU’s development assistance should support sustainable development, security and conflict prevention.
Future of Europe.original: "Unionin tulee edistää rauhaa ja demokratiaa, tasa-arvoa ja ihmisoikeuksien toteutumista. Erityisesti on kiinnitettävä huomiota lasten asemaan ja siihen, ettei kehitysyhteistyöllä vahvisteta autoritaarisia hallintoja. EU:n kehitysyhteistyön tulee tukea kestävää kehitystä, turvallisuutta ja konfliktien ehkäisyä." (https://www.keskusta.fi/Suomeksi/Politiikka/Keskustan-politiikka-A-O#e)

Environment.english: Finland should be built into a carbon neutral society where the interaction between the economy and the environment is harmonious and according to the principles of sustainable development. Material wellbeing cannot be pursued at the expense of nature.
Environment.original: "Suomesta tulee rakentaa hiilineutraali yhteiskunta, jossa talouden ja ympäristön vuorovaikutus on kestävän kehityksen mukaista kumppanuutta. Aineellista hyvinvointia ei voida kasvattaa luonnon kustannuksella." (https://www.keskusta.fi/Suomeksi/Politiikka/Tavoitteet/Ymparisto,-energia-ja-ilmasto)

Employment.english: The misuse of interns as a replacement for hired workforce should be stopped.
Employment.original: "Työharjoittelijoiden väärinkäyttö palkatun työvoiman korvaajana on lopetettava."

Digital Revolution.english: Using digital knowledge and services, as well as the internet, are basic rights of a citizen.
Digital Revolution.original: "Kansalaisen perusoikeuksiin kuuluvat myös digitaalisen tiedon ja palveluiden sekä verkkoyhteyksien käyttö."

Political Participation.english: New democratic drafting methods, like citizenship forums for discussion and ideas, should be created to support decision making in the Union. These citizen forums can also be given the right to initiate laws.
Political Participation.original: "Unionin päätöksentekoa tukemaan on kehitettävä uusia demokraattisia valmistelumuotoja, kuten pohdiskelevia ja keskustelevia kansalaisfoorumeita, joille voidaan antaa myös lakialoiteoikeus tai muu merkittävä asema." 2

Investing in Youth.english: If all work is valuable one also ought to pay for it fairly. Europe wide youth unemployment must not be solved by making the young a low wage workforce, but by furthering the creation of real employment and educational opportunities.
Investing in Youth.original: "Jos kaikki työ on arvokasta, siitä pitää myös maksaa reilusti. Euroopan laajuista nuorisotyöttömyyttä ei pidä ratkaista tekemällä nuorista matalapalkkareserviä, vaan edistämällä oikeiden työpaikkojen ja koulutusmahdollisuuksien syntymistä." 4

Future of Europe.english: Instead of being free trade and market oriented, the strengthening of human rights, equality and global peace should be the focal points of developing the European Union. The EU should take the place of the UK and France at the UN's Security Council.
Future of Europe.original: "Talouden vapauttamisen ja markkinakeskeisyyden sijaan Euroopan unionin kehittämisen lähtökohdaksi on otettava ihmisoikeuksien, tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden vahvistaminen, sekä globaali rauhan edistäminen. -- EU:n on otettava Britannian ja Ranskan paikka YK:n turvallisuusneuvostossa." 5, 6

Employment.english: The EU must put an end to social dumping, to zero-hours contracts, to low-paid jobs and to unfair internships.
Employment.original: EU:n tulee lopettaa määräaikasten työsopimusten solmiminen pelkästään kulujen säästämiseksi, nollasopimukset, alhainen palkka sekä epäreilut työharjoittelut.

Digital Revolution.english: Personal data belongs to individual citizens, not to companies or governments. Privacy must be respected.
Digital Revolution.original: Henkilökohtainen virtuaalinen data kuuluu yksityisille ihmisille, ei yhtiöille eikä valtioille. Yksityisyydensuojaa tulee kunnioittaa.

Political Participation.english: Citizens must be better heard and have a more active say through direct democracy.
Political Participation.original: Kansalaisia täytyy kuulla paremmin ja heillä tulee olla aktiivisempi sananvalta suoran demokratian kautta.

Investing in Youth.english: Widespread unemployment, particularly youth unemployment and old age poverty, are key elements of injustice. Political measures that promise relief, such as the European Youth Guarantee Scheme, will not be successful unless they are adequately funded and above all underpinned by a strong policy of job creation.
Investing in Youth.original: Laajalle levinnyt työttömyys, erityisesti nuorisotyöttömyys sekä vanhusten köyhyys, ovat tärkeitä epätasa-arvon ainesosia. Poliittisen toimet, jotka lupaavat näihin lievitystä, kuten eurooppalainen nuorisotakuuprojekti, eivät tule onnistumaan, ellevät ne ole riittävästi rahoitettuja ja ennen kaikkea vahvan työllistämispolitiikan tukemia.

Future of Europe.english: We want the EU to establish a value-driven common foreign policy and to play an important international role, to address the structural causes of poverty, promoting global justice and solidarity, peace, and the defence of global common goods.
Future of Europe.original: Haluamme, että EU toteuttaa arvolähtöistä yhteistä ulkopolitiikkaa ja ottaa vahvan kansainvälisen roolin köyhyyden rakenteellisten syiden käsittelyssä, ajaen yleismaailmallista oikeutta ja solidaarisuutta, rauhaa ja yleismaailmallisten luonnonvarojen puolustamista.

Environment.english: Sustainability must be put at the heart of every major economic decision. We want to see environmental and biodiversity protection and sustainable development given international priority.
Environment.original: Kestävän kehityksen tulee olla jokaisen suuren taloudellisen päätöksen kulmakivenä. Haluamme, että ympäristön ja biodiversiteetin suojelemiselle sekä kestävälle kehitykselle annetaan etusija kansainvälisesti.

Digital Revolution.english: We want a functioning digital internal market.
Digital Revolution.original: "Sähköisten palveluiden sisämarkkinoita on kehitettävä. Eräs myönteinen esimerkki tästä on nk. verkkovierailumaksujen hintakatto, jonka avulla säädellään operaattorien veloittamia maksuja EU:n sisäisestä televiestinnästä." (http://www.sfp.fi/sites/default/files/Dokument/Program_fi/RKP_EUohjelma2014.pdf, p. 1)

Investing in Youth.english: Growing youth unemployment is one of the biggest challenges that Europe will face and is to be taken seriously at all levels. Assertive measures are to be taken to prevent youth unemployment, for example by a Europe-wide comprehensive youth guarantee scheme and by investing in mobility in education as well as in employment.
Investing in Youth.original: "Kasvava nuorisotyöttömyys on yksi suurimmista haasteista, joita Eurooppa joutuu kohtaamaan, ja se on otettava vakavasti kaikilla tasoilla. On pyrittävä määrätietoisin toimin ehkäisemään nuorisotyöttömyyttä esimerkiksi koko Euroopan kattavan nuorisotakuun avulla ja panostamalla liikkuvuuteen sekä koulutussektorilla että työelämässä." (http://www.sfp.fi/sites/default/files/Dokument/Program_fi/RKP_EUohjelma2014.pdf, p. 2)

Future of Europe.english: The EU needs a functioning foreign and security policy. The High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security has to take a more visible role on the global stage. The EU should be a global actor that bears its responsibility in development policy, for example by signing fair trade treaties.
Future of Europe.original: "EU tarvitsee toimivaa ulko- ja turvallisuuspolitiikkaa. EU:n ulkoasioiden ja turvallisuuspolitiikan korkean edustajan on otettava huomattavasti näkyvämpi rooli globaalilla näyttämöllä. EU:n tulee olla globaali toimija, joka kantaa vastuunsa kehityspolitiikasta muun muassa solmimalla oikeudenmukaisia kauppasopimuksia." (http://www.sfp.fi/sites/default/files/Dokument/Program_fi/RKP_EUohjelma2014.pdf, pp. 2, 3)

Employment.original: "Työelämä- ja yrittäjyyskasvatusta on lisättävä peruskouluja lukio-opetukseen." (http://www.kd.fi/KD/www/fi/yhteystiedot/puolueorganisaatio/Linjapaperi2013_puoluekokouksen_paattama.pdf, p. 30)

Digital Revolution.english: Cyber security threats should increasingly be taken into account when designing overall security, responses to crises and preparation to counter threats. Society should concentrate on protecting the data of citizens and the economy.
Digital Revolution.original: "Kyberturvallisuusuhka pitäisi entistä enemmän ottaa huomioon kokonaisturvallisuuden, huoltovarmuuden ja varautumisen suunnittelussa. Yhteiskunnan on keskityttävä kansalaisten tietojen ja talouden suojeluun." (http://www.kd.fi/KD/www/fi/yhteystiedot/puolueorganisaatio/Linjapaperi2013_puoluekokouksen_paattama.pdf, p. 18)

Investing in Youth.english: Battling youth employment has to be elevated to become the top priority of the EU countries. Preventing unemployment should primarily be done with national measures and national funds.
Investing in Youth.original: "Nuorisotyöttömyyden nujertaminen on nostettava EU-alueen kärkihankkeeksi. Työttömyyden torjuminen tulee toteuttaa ensisijaisesti kansallisin toimenpitein ja kansallisin varoin." (http://www.kd.fi/KD/www/fi/ajankohtaista/index.php?we_objectID=8810)

Future of Europe.english: The EU is an important international actor and it should use its position to further stability, democracy and human rights in the world. The EU should bring its eastern and southern neighbours onto the road of peaceful development that is  democratic and that respects human rights.
Future of Europe.original: "EU on merkittävä kansainvälinen toimija ja sen tulee käyttää asemaansa vakauden, demokratian ja ihmisoikeuksien edistämiseksi maailmassa. EU:n on saatava itäiset ja eteläiset naapurivaltiot rauhanomaisen, demokraattien ja ihmisoikeuksia kunnioittavan kehityksen tielle. (http://kd.fi/KD/www/fi/politiikka/Ohjelmat/Vaaliohjelma/index.php)"

Environment.english: Environmental problems respect no borders. We want to commit to the protection of the environment and its biodiversity for future generations. Sustainable use of the environment should be furthered and pollution should be prevented without causing unreasonable damage to the competitiveness of the EU or its businesses.
Environment.original: "Ympäristöongelmat eivät tunne rajoja. Me haluamme sitoutua ympäristön suojeluun ja luonnon monimuotoisuuden säilyttämiseen tuleville sukupolville. --Ympäristön kestävää käyttöä on edistettävä ja luonnon saastumista torjuttava aiheuttamatta kohtuutonta haittaa EU-alueen kilpailukyvylle ja elinkeinoelämälle. (http://www.kd.fi/KD/www/fi/yhteystiedot/puolueorganisaatio/Linjapaperi2013_puoluekokouksen_paattama.pdf, pp. 10, 11)"

Employment.english: Internships enable the replacement of real jobs by a person paid below the minimum wage (SMIC)  and exploited at will.
Employment.original: Bien entendu, les stages permettent aussi de remplacer de véritables emplois par une main d'œuvre payée en dessous du Smic et totalement corvéable. https://npa2009.org/content/pr%C3%A9carit%C3%A9-pas-de-changement-pour-les-jeunes

Digital Revolution.english: The total abolition of areas that are not covered, or badly covered, by  broadband internet access are just  examples of the public  taking matters back into the public arena, which will be supported by our Regional Council.
Digital Revolution.original: la suppression totale des zones non éligibles ou mal desservies par le haut-débit, ne sont que quelques exemples du vaste chantier de réappropriation de l’espace public par le public que nos élus défendront dans le Conseil Régional. https://npa2009.org/content/la-liste-du-tarn

Political Participation.english: For us, in a real democracy, there would be the opportunity to decide at any level - local, regional or national -  to dismiss representatives that do not comply with their mandates.

Investing in Youth.english: Young people must be able to be trained, to choose their own studies and life choices and seek a first job without being dependent on their family or on any casual work. There is a need for an 'autonomy allowance', on a par with the SMIC (minimum salary) funded, as with retirement pensions, by social dues and managed by both young people and elected employees.
Investing in Youth.original: Les jeunes doivent pouvoir se former, faire leurs choix d’études et de vie et chercher un premier emploi sans dépendre de leur famille ou d’un petit boulot. Il faut donc une allocation d’autonomie, à hauteur du SMIC, financée comme les retraites par des cotisations sociales et gérées par des jeunes et des salariés élus. https://npa2009.org/sites/default/files/Programme%20POUTOU%202012.pdf

Future of Europe.english: Both the EU and the Euro seriously endanger the European idea, the idea of solidarity among the people, and the objectives of fraternal cooperation  between  the citizens of the continent.
Future of Europe.original: L’Union européenne et l’euro "mettent gravement en danger l’idée européenne, les sentiments de solidarité et l’objectif d’une collaboration fraternelle entre les peuples du continent" https://npa2009.org/sites/default/files/Programme%20POUTOU%202012.pdf

Environment.english: An exit from nuclear power  within ten years and its replacement with the development of renewable energy.
Environment.original:
La sortie du nucléaire en dix ans grâce au développement des énergies
renouvelables https://npa2009.org/sites/default/files/Programme%20POUTOU%202012.pdf

Employment.english: Internships will be limited:  there will be an obligation to pay a wage at half the minimum  (SMIC) from the first month, and a limit on the duration of no more than six months.
Employment.original: Nous mettrons en  place un système d'allocations financées pour les jeunes en formation, par la solidarité nationale, et pour ceux en recherche d'un premier emploi, par la Sécurité sociale professionnelle http://www.jean-luc-melenchon.fr/brochures/humain_dabord.pdf

Digital Revolution.english: We will put a stop to all agreements that provide personal information to the government of the US about European citizens under cover of the battle against terrorism.
Digital Revolution.original: Nous mettrons en échec les accords qui livrent les données personnelles des citoyens européens au gouvernement des Etats-Unis sous couvert de lutte contre le terrorisme http://www.pcf.fr/53413

Political Participation.english: Summon a constituent assembly to found a new republic, notably to recognise  corporate citizenship, and to widen the scope of  participatory democracy.
Political Participation.original: Convoquer une assemblée constituante pour fonder une nouvelle République, reconnaissant notamment la citoyenneté d'entreprise, et généralisant la démocratie participative. http://www.pcf.fr/18541

Investing in Youth.english: We will create a social status for all  young people allowing them to become independent.
Investing in Youth.original: Nous créerons un statut social pour tous les jeunes permettant leur autonomie http://www.jean-luc-melenchon.fr/brochures/humain_dabord.pdf

Future of Europe.english: Withdraw France from NATO in order to recover our independence, break away from the Atlantic alignment, and fight for denuclearisation and multilateral disarmament
Future of Europe.original: Retirer la France de l'Otan pour retrouver notre indépendance, rompre avec l'alignement atlantiste et agir pour la dénucléarisation et le désarmement multilatéral. http://www.pcf.fr/18541

Environment.english: Put into question the pact for the Euro and set up a European Social, Ecological and United Development Fund.
Environment.original: Remettre en cause le pacte pour l'Euro+ et mettre en place un Fond de développement social, écologique et solidaire européen. http://www.pcf.fr/18541

Employment.english: We will set up an Employment Plan for young farmers, which will include: apprenticeships; identification of small projects on which they could work under supervision;  and training in  ecologically-friendly agricultural techniques.
Employment.original: La mise en place d'un Plan Emploi pour l'installation des Jeunes Agriculteurs, articulé notamment sur des processus d'apprentissage (initial ou continu), de recherche et d'accompagnement pour promouvoir les projets de petit taille et les techniques de culture agro-écologique, http://www.alliance-ecologiste-independante.com/nos-propositions/nos-propositions-concretes/21-nos-propositions-concretes/302-pacte-pour-lagriculture
