Digital Revolution.original: O Governo estabelecerá um período de um a dois anos para elaborar legislação respeitante à adaptação do Código do Direito de Autor e dos Direitos Conexos às novas realidades do mundo digital.

Political Participation.english: The influence of the European Parliament, as the only directly elected institution by universal suffrage, should be enhanced, whether by developing mechanisms for the democratic accountability of other institutions, or by allowing the parliament to initiate legislation
Political Participation.original: O peso do Parlamento Europeu, enquanto única instituição directamente eleita por sufrágio universal, deve ser potenciado, seja desenvolvendo os mecanismos de responsabilização democrática das demais instituições, seja consagrando, em termos prudentes, a capacidade de iniciativa legislativa.

Investing in Youth.english: In the framework of the European strategy for job creation, there is an absolute need to prioritise measures to fight youth and long-term unemployment.
Investing in Youth.original:
É fundamental levar por diante o programa Garantia para a Juventude, já iniciado
em 2014, aplicável a todos os jovens com menos de 30 anos.  Tal programa visa assegurar uma proposta de qualidade em matéria de emprego, formação contínua, contrato de aprendizagem ou estágio profissional no prazo máximo de 4 meses após terem concluído os estudos ou ficado desocupados. (PSD/CDS Manifesto for the 2014 EP Elections, p. 14 http://www.cds.pt/images/stories/europeias2014/manifestoEUROPEIAS2014.pdf )

Future of Europe.english: We affirm our belief in a Europe that defends the values of peace and human rights at a global and continental scale, which promotes social well-being and prosperity, taking full account of  the recognition shown by the award of the Nobel Peace Prize in 2012.
Future of Europe.original: Afirma também a sua crença numa Europa que defenda os valores da paz e dos direitos humanos à escala global e continental, que promova o bem-estar social e a prosperidade, fazendo pleno jus ao reconhecimento evidenciado pela obtenção do Prémio Nobel da Paz em 2012.

Environment.english: The option of a Green Economy is anchored on the view of the environment, energy and sustainable development being good economic opportunities and as a factor in competitiveness. This economic opportunity particularly translates into: protection of the natural heritage; sustainable and efficient use of resources; fighting climate change;  development of clean technologies; and promoting energy efficiency and independence.
Environment.original: A opção pela Economia Verde baseia-se na visão do ambiente, da energia e do desenvolvimento sustentável como uma enorme oportunidade económica e um factor de competitividade. Esta oportunidade económica traduz-se, designadamente, na protecção do património natural, utilização sustentável e eficiente dos recursos, combate às alterações climáticas, desenvolvimento de tecnologias limpas e promoção da eficiência e autonomia energéticas.

Employment.english: We wish to see an effective fight against unemployment; the creation and the promotion of employment with rights; and  a policy of a first job for young people. This should be based upon vibrant economic activity, on the promotion of public employment, on the eradication of labour precarity and on reducing working hours without lowering  the wage.
Employment.original:
O combate efectivo ao desemprego; a criação e promoção de emprego com direitos,
com uma política de primeiro emprego dirigida aos jovens, assente no desenvolvimento
da actividade económica, na dinamização do emprego público, na erradicação da
precariedade e na redução do horário de trabalho, sem diminuição de salário [...]

Political Participation.english: We respect the inalienable right of the Portuguese people to discuss and express themselves, including by referendum, about the content and objectives of present and future agreements and treaties. We support the protection of democracy and national sovereignty, and the defence of effective participation of the people in determining their destiny; strengthening national parliaments' capacity to decide EU policies.

Investing in Youth.english: We wish to see an effective fight against unemployment; the creation and the promotion of employment with rights; and  a policy of a first job for young people. This should be based upon vibrant economic activity, on the promotion of public employment, on the eradication of labour precarity and on reducing working hours without lowering  the wage.

Future of Europe.english: The rejection of militarism and the end of submission to imperialism, to NATO and its war strategy. The rejection of the European Security and Defence / Foreign Security Policy (ESDP / CFSP) of the European Union’s development as an imperialist political-military bloc, as well as the enlargement of NATO and NATO’s overlay of the UN.
Future of Europe.original:
A recusa do militarismo e o fim da submissão ao imperialismo, à NATO e à sua estratégia de guerra. A rejeição da Política Europeia de Segurança e Defesa/Política Externa de Segurança Comum (PESD/PESC), do profundamento da União Europeia
como bloco político-militar imperialista, assim como do alargamento da NATO e da sobreposição da NATO à ONU.  (CDU Manifesto for the 2014 EP Elections, p. 17, http://www.cdu.pt/parlamentoeuropeu2014/)

Environment.english: We propose more subsidies for programmes aimed at the conservation of nature, including The Life Programme. The rejection of the commoditisation of the environment, as exemplified by the creation and functioning of the carbon trading scheme
Environment.original:
O reforço da dotação dos programas destinados à conservação da Natureza, nomeadamente
do Programa Life; [….] A rejeição da mercantilização do ambiente, de que é exemplo a criação e funcionamento
do mercado do carbono/regime de comércio de licenças de emissão. (CDU Manifesto for the 2014 EP Elections, p. 17, http://www.cdu.pt/parlamentoeuropeu2014/)

Employment.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Digital Revolution.english: The recent scandal surrounding espionage carried out by the United States on European countries was the most serious and flagrant example. Citizens’ protection requires a strong position by the EU in defence of personal data.
Digital Revolution.original:
O recente escândalo em torno da espionagem efectuada pelos Estados Unidos aos países europeus foi o exemplo mais grave e flagrante. A proteção dos cidadãos exige uma posição de intransigência
da UE na defesa dos dados pessoais. (Source: BE Manifesto for the 2014 EP election, p. 7, http://www.bloco.org/media/manifestoeuropeias2014.pdf)

Political Participation.english: A Europe of peoples is not possible without democracy and democratic accountability. The most powerful chairs of the Union – of the governments in the Council and of the ECB – must be directly accountable to the citizens through effective democratic control.
Political Participation.original:
Não é possível uma Europa dos povos sem democracia e sem  responsabilização
democrática. As cadeiras mais  poderosas da União – as dos governos, no Conselho, e a do BCE – têm de passar a prestar contas directamente aos cidadãos através de um controlo democrático efectivo. (Source: BE Manifesto for the 2014 EP election, p. 3, http://www.bloco.org/media/manifestoeuropeias2014.pdf)

Investing in Youth.english:
A more robust Union Budget, which would 
permit common projects for employment and the  levelling up of social rights.

Future of Europe.english: The European Union is a peculiar political construction, insofar as it has developed as an undemocratic union of democratic states. The concentration of power in entities that hide themselves from the scrutiny of democratic institutions, and the transfer of political decisions to technocrats, has generated an invisible European power, which overlaps the democratic authorities at the national and European level.
Future of Europe.original:
A União Europeia é uma construção política peculiar, na medida em que se desenvolveu como uma união
não-democrática de Estados democráticos. A concentração de poderes em entidades que se
furtam ao escrutínio das instituições democráticas e a transferência de decisões políticas para a esfera da
“técnica” gerou um poder Europeu invisível, que se sobrepõe às instâncias democráticas, nacionais e europeias.  (Source: BE Manifesto for the 2014 EP election, p. 5,  http://www.bloco.org/media/manifestoeuropeias2014.pdf)

Environment.english: The protection of environmentally sustainable policies that create jobs remains essential to the economy.
Environment.original:
A protecção de políticas de desenvolvimento social e ambientalmente
sustentáveis, que criem emprego, continua a ser essencial para a economia. (BE Manifesto for the 2011 legislative election, p. 18)

Employment.english: We need to create new funding conditions in connection with the universities that encourage entrepreneurship among young people with innovative projects and with market acceptance; to develop exchange projects between young Portuguese and the most modern employment sectors at the European and World level; to better induct the new generations into the most dynamic economic activities of the international economy.
Employment.original: Criar novas condições de financiamento, em ligação com as Universidades, que favoreçam o empreendedorismo dos jovens com projectos inovadores e com aceitação no mercado; […] Desenvolver projectos de intercâmbio entre os jovens portugueses e o mundo de trabalho europeu e mundial mais moderno, de forma a melhor inserir as novas gerações nas actividades económicas mais dinâmicas da economia internacional [...]

Digital Revolution.english: We will support the revision of the law aagainst private copying, we need to demonstrate respect for copyright, and search for business models  to allow adequate and equitable payment for authors and performers as, well as the free access to culture and cultural products.
Digital Revolution.original: Defenderá a revisão da lei da cópia privada, uma pedagogia de respeito pelos direitos de autor e a procura de modelos de negócio e outras soluções que permitam a adequada e equitativa remuneração dos autores e intérpretes, bem  como o livre acesso de todos à cultura e aos produtos culturais.  (PS Government Programme, 2009-2013, p. 58, http://www.policy-network.net/uploads/media/17/7060.pdf)

Political Participation.english: We claim with equal determination that this must be a democratic process, participated and controlled by Europeans, and therefore strive for the transformation of European institutions and political practices towards a greater proximity to the citizens. The PS is against attitudes of closure and illegitimate protectionism, and firmly opposes the idea of a fortress Europe, that is obsessed with its own privileges and indifferent to the fate of other peoples.
Political Participation.original:
Reclama com igual firmeza que esse seja
um processo democrático, participado e controlado pelos cidadãos europeus, e
pugna, portanto, por uma transformação das instituições e das práticas políticas
europeias, no sentido da sua maior aproximação aos cidadãos. O PS é contrário às atitudes de fechamento e proteccionismo ilegítimo, e frontalmente
adversário da ideia de uma Europa-fortaleza, obcecada com os seus próprios
privilégios e indiferente à sorte dos restantes povos. (PS Declaration of principles, 2010, p. 18)

Investing in Youth.english: We need to create new funding conditions in connection with the universities that encourage entrepreneurship among young people with innovative projects and with market acceptance; to develop exchange projects between young Portuguese and the most modern employment sectors at the European and World level; to better induct the new generations into the most dynamic economic activities of the international economy.
Investing in Youth.original: Criar novas condições de financiamento, em ligação com as Universidades, que favoreçam o empreendedorismo dos jovens com projectos inovadores e com aceitação no mercado; […] Desenvolver projectos de intercâmbio entre os jovens portugueses e o mundo de trabalho europeu e mundial mais moderno, de forma a melhor inserir as novas gerações nas actividades económicas mais dinâmicas da economia internacional [...]

Future of Europe.english: The PS sees European integration as a reference for a new world order guided by the principles of cooperation, mutual respect, solidarity, law, and a sustainable relationship between man and nature.
Future of Europe.original: O PS vê a construção europeia como uma referência para uma nova ordem mundial orientada pelos princípios da cooperação, do respeito mútuo, da solidariedade, do Direito e de uma relação sustentável entre o Homem e a Natureza. (PS Declaration of principles, 2010, p. 17)

Environment.english: Our first commitment is to a greener economy, using more sources of renewable energy. Reducing the country’s dependence on oil is a national priority: either because it is a scarce commodity; or because its use has a significant environmental impact; or because dependence, due to the importance of oil, is causing part of the country’s external debt, which must be reduced.
Environment.original: Neste quadro, o nosso primeiro compromisso é com uma economia mais verde, com mais energia de base renovável. A redução da dependência energética do País face ao petróleo é uma necessidade nacional, seja porque se trata de um bem escasso, seja porque a sua utilização tem impactos ambientais significativos, seja porque essa dependência, devido à importância de petróleo, é causadora de parte do endividamento externo do País, que importa reduzir.(PS Government Programme, 2009-2013, p. 57 http://www.policy-network.net/uploads/media/17/7060.pdf)

Employment.english: One in every two young people cannot find jobs. The Youth Guarantee, recommended by the Commission to the member states, should be compulsory. However, the sustainability of this system will only be guaranteed if more funds are allocated to it and if its implementation by member states is annually monitored and evaluated.
Employment.original: Por outras palavras, um em cada dois jovens não consegue arranjar emprego. A Garantia Jovem, recomendada pela Comissão aos estados-membro, deve ser tornada obrigatória. Contudo, a sustentabilidade deste sistema só será garantida se lhe forem atribuídos mais fundos e se a sua implementação pelos estados-membro for monitorizada e avaliada anualmente.

Digital Revolution.english: Our political programme is to fight for freedom in all areas: in data protection and informed consent; in freedom of access to information and sharing of knowledge; in the prohibition of state cyber-surveillance without prior judicial approval.
Digital Revolution.original: É programa político do LIVRE lutar pela liberdade em todos os seus domínios: […] Seja pela proteção de dados e pelo consentimento informado […] seja pela liberdade de acesso a informação e de partilha de conhecimentos; seja pela proibição da cibervigilancia estatal sem controlo da legalidade por parte das instancias jurisdicionais.

Political Participation.english: We propose the election of the European Commission by the European Parliament, so that it becomes an executive organ of the EU accountable to European citizens.
Political Participation.original:
O LIVRE defende: A eleição da Comissão Europeia a partir do Parlamento Europeu, para que se constitua num executivo da União e seja obrigada a prestar contas aos
Cidadãos europeus. (Source, LIVRE Political Programme, p. 14, http://livrept.net/)

Investing in Youth.english: One in every two young people cannot find jobs. The Youth Guarantee, recommended by the Commission to the member states, should be compulsory. However, the sustainability of this system will only be guaranteed if more funds are allocated to it and if its implementation by member states is annually monitored and evaluated.
Investing in Youth.original: No Parlamento Europeu, o LIVRE proporá que a Garantia Jovem passe a ser determinada por uma diretiva e alvo de um fundo reforçado. Utilizaremos como base legal o artigo 149º, que estabelece que “o Parlamento Europeu e o Conselho podem adotar incentivos para apoiar ações no campo do emprego, em particular através do recurso a projetos-piloto” para propormos uma cooperação reforçada que combata a fuga de cérebros e ajude a fixar capital humano nos países que têm sido mais afetados pela crise.   (Source: LIVRE Manifesto for the 2014 EP election, p. 21-22, http://livrept.net/67-medidas-para-mudar-mesmo-uniao-europeia)

Future of Europe.english: We reject any idea of European superiority or of global competition between world regions, instead we consider overcoming the rivalries between nations as a goal to be defended and expanded every day.
Future of Europe.original: […] [atitude europeia do LIVRE]  recusa qualquer ideia de superioridade europeia ou competição global entre regiões do mundo, mas vê a superação das rivalidades entre nações como um progresso a ser defendido e expandido todos os dias, na Europa e no mundo [...].  (Source: LIVRE Manifesto for the 2014 EP election, p. 43, http://livrept.net/67-medidas-para-mudar-mesmo-uniao-europeia)

Environment.english: For us, the Commission should, in close cooperation with the European Parliament, take the opportunities provided by the negotiation of the Rural Development Programs to limit the use of European funds in agricultural practices that are harmful to the environment.
Environment.original: Para o LIVRE, a Comissão Europeia deve, em estreita colaboração com o Parlamento Europeu, aproveitar as oportunidades que tem nos processos de negociação dos Programas de Desenvolvimento Rural para limitar o recurso a verbas europeias de práticas agrícolas danosas para o ambiente. (Source: LIVRE Manifesto for the 2014 EP election, p. 30, http://livrept.net/67-medidas-para-mudar-mesmo-uniao-europeia)

Employment.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Digital Revolution.english: All Europeans should  have access to high-speed internet.
Digital Revolution.original: Uma agenda digital para a europa [….] todos os europeus devem ter acesso à internet de alta velocidade.   [MPT Manifesto for the 2014 EP Election, in Verdade Newspaper,  p.10)

Political Participation.english: We wish to democratise the European Unionby: direct election of the European Commission in plurinational lists; keeping the system of rotating presidencies; and national co-decisions between the Parliament and the Government.
Political Participation.original: Democratizar a União Europeia (eleição directa da comissão europeia em listas plurinacionais, manutenção das presidências rotativas; e co-decisão nacional entre Parlamento  e Governo).  [MPT Manifesto for the 2011 Legislative Election, p. 26, http://aefcup.pt/docs/legislativas2011/MPT.pdf )

Investing in Youth.english: We should be promoting  youth on the move - enhancing the quality and the international attractiveness of Europe's higher education system and providing mobility for students and young professionals. As a concrete proposal, the job vacancies available across Member States should be made more accessible throughout Europe, while professional qualifications and experiences should be properly recognised.
Investing in Youth.original: Juventude em movimento – reforçar a qualidade e a capacidade de atraccão internacional do sistema de ensino superior europeu, provendo a mobilidade dos estudantes e dos jovens profissionais. Enquanto acção concreta, as vagas existentes em todos o Estados-Membros devem ser mais facilmente acessíveis em toda a europa e as qualificações e experiencia profissional reconhecidas de forma adequada.

Future of Europe.english: In the European Parliament our MEPs will defend: the founding principles of Europe, for a Europe of citizens, for a Europe of freedom, for a Europe of peace, solidarity and citizenship.
Future of Europe.original: No Parlamento Europeu os deputados do MPT defenderão: os princípios originários da Europa, por uma Europa dos cidadãos, por Europa da Liberdade, uma Europa da Paz, da Solidariedade e da Cidadania.    [MPT Manifesto for the 2014 EP Election, in Verdade Newspaper,  p.3)

Environment.english: We support policies that eliminate the environmental privileges granted to some industrial sectors, such as cement; setting equal pollutant emission limits, whatever their origin; granting support to the industries that ensure compliance with environmental rules; penalizing polluting industries, by law enforcement.
Environment.original: Eliminar os privilégios ambientais de que beneficiam alguns sectores industriais, nomeadamente as cimenteiras, fixando iguais limites de emissão poluentes, seja qual for a sua origem. Atribuir apoios exclusivamente à indústria que assegure o cumprimento de regras ambientais. Penalizar as indústrias poluentes cumprindo as leis em vigor.  [MPT Manifesto for the 2011 Legislative Election, p.17)

Employment.english: Youth at the crossroads: fighting precarious work.  Support for Entrepreneurship and Innovation. Support for a first home. Other incentives for settlement in Portugal.
Employment.original: Juventude à rasca: Combater a precariedade no trabalho. Apoio aos Empreendorismo e à Inovação. Apoios à 1ª Habitação. Outros incentivos à fixação em Portugal.

Digital Revolution.english: No European Election Manifesto or No relevant statement in manifesto was found

Political Participation.english: Therefore strengthening the legitimacy of European institutions goes hand in hand with the renewal of its powers, for the  achievement of common goals founded in a EU Constitution. This is a key issue for democratic reform and for the progressive affirmation of European citizenship, which does not replace, but complements and invigorates, national citizenship.
Political Participation.original:
Por isso o reforço da
legitimação das instituições europeias vai de par com a renovação dos seus poderes, para a realização dos objectivos comuns, fundados numa Constituição da
União Europeia; e esta é uma questão essencial da reforma democrática de tais instituições e da progressiva afirmação de uma cidadania europeia, que não
substitui, antes complementa e revigora, as cidadanias nacionais.  (Declaration of principles, http://www.partidotrabalhista.com/princiacutepios-ptp.html)

Future of Europe.english: We are committed to the construction and development process of the European Union, including the deepening of its political dimension, as the logical and necessary consequence of a collective project of peace, well-being and solidarity.
Future of Europe.original:
O PTP empenha-se no processo de construção e desenvolvimento da União Europeia, incluindo o aprofundamento da sua dimensão política, como
consequência lógica e necessária do projecto colectivo de paz, bem-estar e solidariedade. (Declaration of principles, http://www.partidotrabalhista.com/princiacutepios-ptp.html)

Environment.english: Eenvironmental protection and the creation of an ecological consciousness constitute one of the noblest causes and one of the most pressing needs of our time. The principles of prevention, subsidiarity and participation should be extended and applied to all public policies directly dealing with development, territory and nature, and should be promoted as basic guidelines for  the conduct of all citizens, either workers, entrepreneurs or consumers.
Environment.original:
A defesa do ambiente e a criação de uma consciência ecológica constituem uma das causas mais nobres e uma das necessidades mais prementes do nosso
tempo. Os princípios da precaução, da subsidiariedade e da participação devem ser estendidos e aplicados a todas as políticas públicas que lidam directamente
com o desenvolvimento, o território e a natureza, e devem ser difundidos como uma orientação básica do comportamento de todos os cidadãos, enquanto
trabalhadores, empresários ou consumidores. (Declaration of principles, http://www.partidotrabalhista.com/princiacutepios-ptp.html)

Employment.english: There are today many small and medium-sized companies that could offer only a small number of internships for students from universities. For these firms it is very difficult to sign agreements with the universities, according to the current law. We believe that the law should become more flexible and allow the participation of smaller companies. The quality of internships will not suffer because the legal responsibility will remain the same.
Employment.original: Există în prezent multe companii mici sau mijlocii care ar putea oferi un număr mic locuri de practică, pentru studenţi de la facultăţi sau universităţi diferite. Pentru aceste firme e foarte complicat să semneze convenţii cu universităţile, cum prevede legea actuală. Eu cred că legea trebuie să fie mai flexibilă, pentru a coopta şi companiile mai mici. Calitatea programelor de practică nu va avea de suferit pentru că exact aceeaşi răspundere juridică pe care şi-o asumă acum angajatorii în contractele cu universităţile, se va regăsi în contractele individuale de practică încheiate cu fiecare student practicant", a declarat Cătălina Ştefănescu.

Digital Revolution.english: The establishment of new rules will allow all national surveillance institutions to severely sanction companies which violate rules of personal data protection. Many institutions have been privatised over the last few years which use data of a personal nature over which the Romanian state has no control.
Digital Revolution.original: Valeriu Zgonea a adăugat că instituirea de noi reguli va permite fiecărei autorităţi de supraveghere naţională să sancţioneze drastic companiile care vor încălca normele de protecţie a datelor cu caracter personal, atenţionând că sunt sunt foarte multe instituţii care au fost privatizate în ultimii ani şi care folosesc date cu caracter personal asupra utilizării cărora statul român nu deţine controlul.source: http://www.psd.ro/media/stiri/valeriu-zgonea-am-speranta-ca-vom-reusi-sa-intarim-increderea-cetateanului-in-institutiile-care-ii-protejeaza-datele-personale/

Political Participation.english: Unfortunately, for many citizens voting is seen in negative terms. As a direct result, through this lack of participation, they lose their right to decide and they lose the opportunity to become involved in the life of our society.
Political Participation.original: Din păcate însă, pentru mulți cetățeni votul este văzut în mod negativ, consecința directă a acestui fapt fiind că nu se prezintă la vot. Aceștia ar trebui să se gândească la faptul că, prin această lipsa de participare, pierd dreptul de a vota, de a alege, pierd oportunitatea de a se implica în viața societății. source: http://www.psd.ro/media/comunicate/senatorul-psd-gheorghe-saghian-responsabilitatea-votului/

Investing in Youth.english: Romania is affected by youth unemployment; it is not enough to say that we want to create jobs.
Investing in Youth.original: Victor Ponta: Romania este afectata de somajul in randul tinerilor; nu este suficient sa spunem ca facem locuri de munca. Source: http://www.psd.ro/media/stiri/victor-ponta-romania-este-afectata-de-somajul-in-randul-tinerilor-nu-este-suficient-sa-spunem-ca-trebuie-sa-facem-locuri-de-munca/

Future of Europe.english: We wish to shorten the decision chain, because the capacity of reaction and intervention at a local level is always faster and more efficient than following the bureaucratic channels between local, central and other institutions. The idea that someone from Bucharest always decides everything that  happens in every city or town in this country is wrong, and is  running away from responsability for the lack of transparency that affects the daily activities of public institutions.
Future of Europe.original: Ne mai dorim – şi asta se va realiza – scurtarea lanţului decizional, deoarece capacitatea de reacţie, de decizie şi de intervenţie la nivel local este întotdeauna, este întotdeauna mai rapidă şi mai eficientă decât urmarea căilor birocratice între local, central, diverse alte instituţii. [...] Ideea că cineva la Bucureşti decide întotdeauna pentru tot ce se întâmplă în fiecare oraş şi comună din această ţară era o fugă de răspundere şi era o lipsă de transparenţă care a afectat şi afectează zi de zi activitatea instituţiilor publice. source: http://www.psd.ro/media/transcrieri/discurs-sustinut-de-victor-ponta-premierul-romaniei-si-presedintele-psd-la-palatul-parlamentului/

Environment.english: Tthrough the programme that has been proposed to Parliament, the Government is confirming its realistic and pragmatic measures, which must not have either a centre-left or a centre-right ideological pattern, but a clear pattern of pragmatism, of sustainability and providing real answers to the expectations of the people who voted in 2012.
Environment.original: Premierul a explicat că, prin programul pus la dispoziţia Parlamentului, Guvernul confirmă 'măsurile realiste, pragmatice de guvernare, măsuri care trebuie să aibă nu doar o tentă ideologică de centru-stânga, de centru-dreapta, ci mai ales o tentă foarte clară de pragmatism, de sustenabilitate, şi de a răspunde în mod real aşteptărilor populaţiei care a votat în anul 2012

Employment.english: The main point of the system proposed by the Government is that it guarantees, through a work contract, access to the labour market of new graduates, adding the status of intern. We took an important step towards reducing the gap between the educational system and the labour market; hoewever, main problems  remain unresolved. Additional measures are necessary in order to reduce the unemployment rate among young people.
Employment.original: Principalul punct forte al sistemului propus de Guvern este acela că garantează, prin contract de muncă, ocupaţionalitatea tinerilor absolvenţi, iar la aceasta se adaugă şi statutul de stagiar. [..] Am făcut un pas important spre reducerea golului dintre sistemul de învăţământ şi piaţa muncii, însă numeroase probleme rămân în continuare fără răspuns. Employment.english: Fair access to internships is an important for increasing social mobility. The hiring of interns should be as transparent and nondiscriminatory as the hiring of permanent employees, and no-one should be forced to take an unpaid internship or required to pay in order to work.

Digital Revolution.english: Greens believe that EU data protection legislation should be based on the principles of government openness and transparency while protecting citizens' right to privacy. Political Participation.english: The Green Party wants a reformed Europe with governing institutions designed to resist capture by corporations and instead work democratically and cooperatively in the public interest. We will promote self-determination of nations and regions acting independently on local issues, whilst protecting the ability to cooperate on global issues that affect us all, like fisheries protection, climate change or human rights.

Investing in Youth.english: With 5.5 million young people under 25 unemployed across the EU, youth unemployment is one of the most pressing problems facing Europe today. The youth unemployment situation is so critical we risk losing a generation to social exclusion while gambling with the economic and social future of the EU. Through this vote, a large majority in the parliament have called for some very concrete initiatives. Now it's up to the Commission to put it into practice. 5.5 million young people and counting are waiting for action.

Future of Europe.english: The Common Foreign & Security Policy arrangements are opposed by us. We believe the EU is not the appropriate European body for such issues. However, in areas where the member countries of the EU have a consensus our country should take a positive role in developing and implementing a consensual common foreign policy under the CFSP. Our country should engage in debate against non consensual proposals, and resist all proposals to develop and implement common foreign policy in areas where no consensus exists.

Environment.english: In government, we will take bold, responsible and scientifically credible action to avoid catastrophic climate change. We will apply a contraction and convergence strategy to reduce emissions to a safe and equal per-capita level. Pursuing the necessary annual reductions of around 10% will create many jobs. We will provide free monthly carbon emission allowances and people wanting to use more than their fair share could trade allowances. Total emissions will be capped and will reduce each year in line with our 2030 emission reduction target of 90% on 1990 levels.

Investing in Youth.english: The announcement that hundreds more young people in Scotland are set to be supported into employment has been hailed today as a ‘clear signal of intent’. An additional investment of £6.3 million into Community Jobs Scotland is set to support hundreds of young people into employment, with 10% of the funding ring-fenced to help those with disabilities and long-term illnesses in particular. The Scottish Government has also announced that Community Jobs Scotland will extend the support it offers to 16-24 year olds where previously it had worked with 16-19 year olds.

Future of Europe.english: The party published a manifesto for 'Europe in the World', detailing the Party's vision for the role that the European Union can play in promoting peace and stability in the key areas of international security, development aid, tackling the arms trade, and promoting fair trade.The parrty announced that its Euro-MPs elected next Thursday would campaign in the EU for the establishment of a European Centre for Peace and Reconciliation to assist with the process of conflict resolution in global trouble spots, and for such an institution to be based in Scotland. As part of the campaign, Euro-MPs will write to the new President of the Commission making the case for such an institution.

Environment.english: The possible benefits of such an innovative terminal to a relatively small European country like Scotland are massive. Having the FCSTT at Scapa Flow would put us at the forefront of low cost transhipment port capacity development. The huge savings potential in terms of shipping costs and CO2 emissions would certainly be achievable. The eventual benefit of having direct access to low cost marine renewable energy sources could make Scapa Flow the 'ultimate green port', creating valuable green jobs for Scotland.

Employment.english: We have called for the Welsh Government to implement the EU’s Youth Guarantee with a promise to any young person, who has been unemployed for more than four months, that they will be offered either a job, training or an apprenticeship.

Digital Revolution.english: The Party is demanding answers about  the US PRISM surveillance programme. These revelations raise fundamental questions about  democracy and privacy. The party shares the outrage of many people that US intelligence agencies apparently have easy access to our online personal data. Mass surveillance of citizens is unacceptable. We have to ensure that we adopt the strictest data protection standards in the EU in response to this.

Political Participation.english: All European and national political parties to act immediately to ensure the realisation of gender equality in their nomination procedure ahead of the election of the European Parliament in June – for example through their electoral lists and in the drafting of their programmes. Women and men in Europe to seize the current opportunity to speak up and cast their vote with a view to advancing democracy, gender equality and justice. The EU Member States to fulfil their commitments to democracy and gender equality by ensuring the equal representation of women among the top jobs at EU level.

Investing in Youth.english: The party has called for European Union money to tackle long-term youth unemployment in Wales. The EU had committed six billion Euros to areas with more than 25% youth unemployment, but Wales is excluded because its figure is 22.2%. we will lobby in Europe and elsewhere to access the funding.

Future of Europe.english: Now is not the time to develop an EU army, and called on the EU to focus on involving people in conflict prevention and peaceful work at home and abroad. The party called for the EU to establish a Civilian Peace Corps to involve people with all kinds of skills in helping diffuse and prevent conflicts and foster understanding. If we are to make Europe work we must show it has a clear future role, including internationally. The EU could be a real force for peace if we address all the threats facing people. An effective security policy has to be integrated with policies on poverty, the environment, energy, trade, food and water resources and so on. We must re-focus on building peace.

Environment.english: The EU must not lose sight of the climate crisis. We need serious investment in green jobs to build a sustainable economy.

Employment.english: We need a commitment from you, our business leaders, that you will provide apprenticeships and internship opportunities and that you will act socially responsibly to provide access to employment opportunities for individuals who have been outside the workforce.

Future of Europe.english: To be effective in supporting peace, there is a clear need for the EU to have a more coherent foreign policy capacity. This should not extend to supplanting the independent foreign affairs policy of member countries.

Environment.english: Our view is that the current economic downturn must be used as a springboard to accelerate action to manage climate change. With thousands of jobs already lost across the North due to the recession, we will continue to work at all levels to persuade others that now is the time to create new jobs by moving from our present dangerous and expensive over-reliance on imported fossil fuels.

build a better future. Investing in youth employment now will pay dividends well into the future. The countries that have successfully tackled youth unemployment are those that have made greater
investment in building up the capabilities of people who are unemployed.

Future of Europe.english: Establish a permanent structured cooperation (PSC). Future of Europe.original:
Les libéraux souhaitent : 
• que la défense européenne soit un instrument performant au service d’une politique 
étrangère européenne ambitieuse, proactive et pacificatrice ; • la mise en place de la coopération structurée permanente (CSP). La PSDC peut se 
construire à géométrie variable, chaque Etat prenant part aux opérations ou aux

combler des lacunes capacitaires prioritaires : le ravitaillement en vol, un soutien

des différents marchés ; 
• soutenir la création d'une politique commune de l'énergie qui pourrait être

• assurer l’indépendance énergétique de l’UE au niveau mondial en

• travailler à l’établissement d’un système opérationnel d’échange de quotas 
d’émissions afin de réduire les émissions de CO2 ; 
• inciter le secteur privé à investir dans les énergies renouvelables, accroître les 
investissements dans la recherche et le développement et élargir les 
partenariats public-privé innovants.

Future of Europe.english: We have highlighted the true character of NATO, the EU as an imperialist transnational association set up to serve the interests of the monopolies, of capital and, of course, not of the working classes countries that participate in them.
Future of Europe.original: Αναδείξαμε τον πραγματικό χαρακτήρα του ΝΑΤΟ, της ΕΕ ως ιμπεριαλιστικές διακρατικές ενώσεις που συγκροτήθηκαν για να υπηρετούν τα συμφέροντα των μονοπωλίων, του κεφαλαίου και όχι φυσικά της εργατικής τάξης και των λαϊκών στρωμάτων των χωρών, οι οποίες συμμετέχουν σ' αυτές.

Environment.english: On the road to economic and social development, new technologies will be applied and developed that are more ecologically-friendly, people will become more aware and a compatible working relationship with nature will be restored.
Environment.original:
Σε αυτόν το δρόμο οικονομικής και κοινωνικής ανάπτυξης, στο πλαίσιο της λαϊκής οικονομίας, θα μπουν σε εφαρμογή και θα αναπτυχθούν νέες τεχνολογίες, φιλικότερες προς τη φύση, θα διαμορφωθεί ανάλογη συνείδηση, θα αποκατασταθεί μια συμβατή σχέση εργαζόμενου-φύσης. 

Source: http://www.kke.gr/anakoinoseis_grafeioy_typoy/anakoinosh_toy_grafeioy_typoy_gia_thn_pagkosmia_hmera_gia_to_periballon?morf=0

Employment.english: The EU can help in promoting entreneurship by either creating a specific funding mechanism for companies, or by providing liquidity to Greek banks with special provisions that ensure the money is directed to the real economy and not cronyism.
Employment.original:
Η ΕΕ μπορεί να βοηθήσει σε αυτό, είτε με τη δημιουργία ενός ειδικού μηχανισμού χρηματοδότησης απευθείας σε επιχειρήσεις, είτε παρέχοντας ρευστότητα στις ελληνικές τράπεζες με ειδικές ρήτρες για να κατευθυνθούν τα λεφτά στην πραγματική οικονομία και όχι σε ημέτερους.  

Source: http://topotami.gr/answers-theseis/pos-tha-borouse-na-enischithi-epichirimatikotita/

Political Participation.english: The institutions and generally the mechanisms of the European Union must overcome their bureaucratic nature and take action on behalf of  European citizens.This is their  role, even if they have forgotten it.
Political Participation.original:
Οι θεσμοί και γενικότερα ο μηχανισμός της Ευρωπαϊκής Ένωσης πρέπει να ξεπεράσουν τις γραφειοκρατικές τους αγκυλώσεις και να αναλάβουν δράση στο πλευρό του ευρωπαίου πολίτη, αυτός είναι ο ρόλος τους εξάλλου και ας έχει ξεχαστεί. 

Source:  http://topotami.gr/answers-theseis/mia-dinati-ellada-se-mia-dinati-evropi-2/

Investing in Youth.english: The only real solution to unemployment is to restart the private sector. This will be done through measures such as strengthening liquidity. Also, the funds of the new NSRF for employment grants should be given for employment in businesses or self-employment, rather than "stages" in public. That way young people acquire useful experience and have better chances to continue to work productively.
Investing in Youth.original: Η μόνη πραγματική λύση για την ανεργία είναι να ξαναπάρει μπροστά ο ιδιωτικός τομέας, και όποιοι πολιτικοί το κρύβουν αυτό, κοροϊδεύουν. Αυτό θα γίνει με μέτρα όπως η ενίσχυση της ρευστότητας. Επίσης, τα κονδύλια του νέου ΕΣΠΑ για επιδότηση της εργασίας πρέπει να δίνονται για απασχόληση σε επιχειρήσεις, ή για αυτοαπασχόληση, αντί για stages στο δημόσιο. Έτσι αποκτούν οι νέοι χρήσιμες εμπειρίες και έχουν καλύτερες πιθανότητες να συνεχίσουν να δουλεύουν παραγωγικά.

Future of Europe.english: There should be a pan-European strategy for the further deepening of the Union in the folowing policy areas: development, education, youth, employment, foreign and security.
Future of Europe.original:
Θα πρέπει να υπάρξει μια πανευρωπαϊκή στρατηγική για την περαιτέρω εμβάθυνση της Ένωσης στους τομείς της αναπτυξιακής πολιτικής, της εκπαίδευσης, της πολιτικής για τους νέους, την πολιτική απασχόλησης, την εξωτερική πολιτική και την πολιτική ασφάλειας.  

Source:  http://topotami.gr/answers-theseis/mia-dinati-ellada-se-mia-dinati-evropi-2/

Employment.english: The 'Youth Guarantee' ensures that all young people below the age of 25 will be offered  quality employment, the possibility of continued education, an apprenticeship or traineeship within four months of completion of the official curriculum or loss of employment.
Employment.original: Η «Εγγύηση για τη Νεολαία» εξασφαλίζει ότι σε όλους τους νέους έως την ηλικία των 25 ετών θα προσφέρεται μια ποιοτική θέση εργασίας , δυνατότητα συνέχισης της εκπαίδευσης, μαθητεία ή πρακτική άσκηση εντός τεσσάρων μηνών από την ολοκλήρωση του επίσημου προγράμματος σπουδών ή από την απώλεια θέσης εργασίας

Digital Revolution.english: The right to privacy and in particular the protection of personal data are  fundamental rights.
Digital Revolution.original:
Το δικαίωμα στην ιδιωτική ζωή και συγκεκριμένα η προστασία των προσωπικών δεδομένων συνιστούν επίσης θεμελιώδη δικαιώματα. 

Source: www.ecogreens-gr.org/Docs/.../EGP_Human_Rights_EL.doc

Political Participation.english: We are Europeans, so we want to change Europe, with the participation of citizens. We want to strengthen the European Parliament,  reduce the role and power of the Council (governments) and intergovernmental cooperation;  to be replaced by enhanced democratic governance through the European parliament, in cooperation with national / regional parliaments. We should also institute  pan-European referendums on important issues.
Political Participation.original:
Είμαστε ευρωπαίοι, γι αυτό θέλουμε να αλλάξουμε την Ευρώπη, με τη συμμετοχή των πολιτών. Να ενδυναμώσουμε το  Ευρωκοινοβούλιο, να μειωθεί ο ρόλος και η ισχύς του Συμβουλίου (κυβερνήσεις) και η διακυβερνητική συνεργασία να δώσει τη θέση της σε ενισχυμένη δημοκρατική διακυβέρνηση μέσω ενισχυμένου ευρωκοινοβουλίου, συνεργασίας ευρωκοινοβουλίου και εθνικών/περιφερειακών κοινοβουλίων και πανευρωπαϊκών δημοψηφισμάτων για σημαντικά θέματα. 

Source:  http://www.ecogreens-gr.org/cms/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=5191#sthash.Owb0Y3iz.dpuf

Investing in Youth.english: The only real solution to unemployment is to restart the private sector. This can be done through measures such as strengthening liquidity. In addition, the funds of the new NSRF for employment grants should be given for employment in businesses or self-employment, rather than trainee programmes in public institutions. That way young people will acquire useful experience and have a better chance to continue to work productively.
Investing in Youth.original:
Χρειάζεται διάλογος με τους νέους, νέες προσεγγίσεις, αξιοποίηση καλών πρακτικών κι εμπειριών, καινοτόμα εργαλεία και επαρκής αλλά στοχευμένη χρηματοδότηση εκείνων των πρωτοβουλιών που οδηγούν στην δημιουργία νέων θέσεων εργασίας 

Source:  http://www.ecogreens-gr.org/cms/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=4458:2013-05-07-11-30-57&catid=73:auroparlnews#sthash.Rfa2oOhx.dpuf

Future of Europe.english: We are already heading towards an unprecedented  globalisation, and tomorrow only a united Europe can play a prominent role. We need 'more Europe' to manage global problems and only the EU is able to deal with them effectively.
Future of Europe.original:
Πορευόμαστε ήδη προς μία πρωτόγνωρη ενοποιητική παγκοσμιοποίηση, και αύριο μόνο μία ενωμένη Ευρώπη θα μπορεί να παίζει κάποιον σημαίνοντα ρόλο. Έχουμε ανάγκη από «περισσότερο Ευρώπη» για να διαχειριστούμε τα παγκόσμια προβλήματα και μόνο η ΕΕ είναι ικανή να επεξεργαστεί αποτελεσματικά. 

Source:  http://www.ecogreens-gr.org/cms/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=5173&Itemid=19#sthash.sPisE6W4.dpuf

Environment.english: The challenge of the 21st century is to achieve a better quality of life for everyone, with the decoupling of economic and social prosperity from resource and energy consumption, and minimising environmental impact.
Environment.original:
Η πρόκληση του 21ου αιώνα είναι η επίτευξη καλύτερης ποιότητας ζωής για όλους, με αποσύνδεση της οικονομικής και κοινωνικής ευημερίας από την κατανάλωση πόρων και ενέργειας κι ελαχιστοποίηση των περιβαλλοντικών επιπτώσεων. 

Source:  http://www.ecogreens-gr.org/cms/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=148%3Aeconomy&catid=31%3Aprogram-10&Itemid=19#sthash.miAGWLFc.dpuf

Employment.english: We must develop a new, outward-looking development model, based on investment, entrepreneurship, and trust in the dynamic export-oriented economy, and away from statism and introversion .
Employment.original: Φυγή προς τα εμπρός αποτελεί η δυναμική επιστροφή της χώρας σε αναπτυξιακή τροχιά, η διαμόρφωση δηλαδή ενός νέου, εξωστρεφούς αναπτυξιακού προτύπου, που θα στηρίζεται στις επενδύσεις, στην επιχειρηματικότητα, στην εμπιστοσύνη και στον δυναμικό εξαγωγικό προσανατολισμό της οικονομίας, μακριά από τον κρατισμό και την εσωστρέφεια.

Political Participation.english: The Lisbon Treaty is a positive step towards European integration and we support it, as it supports several of these goals while strengthening the rights of European citizens.
Political Participation.original: Η Συνθήκη της Λισσαβόνας αποτελεί θετικό βήμα προς την ευρωπαϊκή ολοκλήρωση και την στηρίζουμε, καθώς πραγματοποιεί αρκετούς από τους στόχους αυτούς, ενισχύοντας παράλληλα τα δικαιώματα των ευρωπαίων πολιτών.

Investing in Youth.english: The only ways out of the current stalemate are to stop the closures of businesses, and to attract massive investment, which will reduce unemployment, introduce innovation and highlight the comparative advantages of the country.
Investing in Youth.original: Ο μόνος τρόπος να βγούμε από το σημερινό αδιέξοδο είναι να σταματήσει το κλείσιμο επιχειρήσεων, αλλά και να προσελκυστούν μαζικές επενδύσεις, οι οποίες θα ρίξουν την ανεργία, θα εισαγάγουν καινοτομία και θα αναδείξουν τα συγκριτικά πλεονεκτήματα της χώρας.

Future of Europe.english: In a globalised world, no EU country can deal with threats and challenges alone. EU citizens expect the Union and the Member States to be kept together, to act together and to play an effective role on the world stage.
Future of Europe.original: Σε ένα παγκοσμιοποιημένο κόσμο, καμία χώρα της ΕΕ δεν μπορεί να αντιμετωπίσει τις απειλές και τις προκλήσεις μόνη της. Οι πολίτες της ΕΕ αναμένουν από την Ένωση και τα κράτη-μέλη της να παραμένουν ενωμένα, να ενεργούν από κοινού και να διαδραματίζουν αποτελεσματικό ρόλο στην παγκόσμια σκηνή.

Environment.english: Greece does not have the burden of a large industrial manufacturing base, but is a popular tourist destination, with the natural environment as a comparative advantage.It is eviddent that we should dopt strict protection rules, possibly to a greater extent than other Member States.
Environment.original: Για μια χώρα όπως η Ελλάδα που από την μία δεν έχει την επιβάρυνση μιας μεγάλης βιομηχανικής παραγωγής και από την άλλη ως τουριστικός προορισμός βασίζεται στο φυσικό της περιβάλλον, ως συγκριτικό πλεονέκτημα, αποτελεί αυτονόητη επιλογή η υιοθέτηση αυστηρών κανόνων προστασίας του, ενδεχομένως και σε μεγαλύτερο βαθμό από άλλα κράτη-μέλη.

Employment.english: The promotion of exchanges of high school and university students with other countries and cultures is needed, so that our children will adapt to living in an emerging global village.
Employment.original: "Treba je pospeševati izmenjave učenk in učencev, dijakinj in dijakov ter študentk in študentov z drugimi državami in kulturami, da se bodo naši otroci lahko ustrezno privajali na življenje v porajajoči se globalni vasi". Source: http://www.socialnidemokrati.si/predstavitev/program/

Digital Revolution.english: There is a need for 'building the IT infrastructure for new media' .
Digital Revolution.original: "gradnja informacijsko-komunikacijske infrastrukture za uporabo novih medijev" source: http://www.socialnidemokrati.si/predstavitev/program/

Investing in Youth.english: We accept the proposal about a secure European future for young people with proposals for increased EU funding for youth employment.
Investing in Youth.original: "Če je medgeneracijska solidarnost naše vodilo, smo se pripravljeni odpovedati pridobitvam starejših generacij za to, da rešimo vprašanje brezpravnosti mladih". Source: http://www.socialnidemokrati.si/predstavitev/program/  "...sprejeli predlog PES   za varno evropsko prihodnost mladih, s predlogom povečanja EU sredstev za njihovo zaposlovanje". source: http://www.socialnidemokrati.si/page/15/?m

Future of Europe.english: Only a strong and highly integrated EU can ensure that other parts of the world  will raise their quality of life to European levels. We advocate more a united EU in international relations, above all at the UN.
Future of Europe.original: "Samo močna in visoko integrirana Evropska unija lahko zagotovi, da bodo drugi deli sveta dvignili kakovost življenja na evropsko raven. Socialni demokrati zagovarjamo enotnejšo Evropsko unijo v mednarodnih odnosih, predvsem v okviru Organizacije združenih narodov". Source: http://www.socialnidemokrati.si/predstavitev/program/

Environment.english: On the way towards the development of a competitive modern economy, ecologically friendly  technologies need to be introduced for the sustainable management of natural resources and maintaining natural diversity".
Environment.original: "Na poti razvoja konkurenčnega gospodarstva je treba uporabljati sodobne, okoljsko sprejemljive tehnologije z namenom trajnostnega upravljanja z naravnimi viri in ohranjanja naravne raznolikosti". Source: http://www.socialnidemokrati.si/predstavitev/program/
